With reference to the Scheme for Economic Empowerment of Denotified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (SEED), consider the following statements:
1. It is a Central Sector scheme.
2. It is administered by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
3. It provides PM-JAY coverage and PMAY housing support.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
165.x: SEED is a Central Sector scheme of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment and includes PM-JAY coverage and PMAY housing support.
165.tq: Combine scheme type, nodal Ministry and benefits.

165.s: The National Pension System was introduced for government staff in 2004 and extended to all citizens in:
165.x: The NPS was introduced for government staff in 2004 and extended to all citizens in 2009.
165.tq: Discriminate between the two dates attached to the same scheme.

165.s: Which of the following schemes were launched on 9 May 2015?
165.x: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana, Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana and Atal Pension Yojana were launched on 9 May 2015.
165.tq: Match the launch date with the correct cluster of schemes.

165.s:
Consider the following statements about launch years:
1. PM-JAY was launched in September 2018.
2. UPS and NPS Vatsalya belong to 2025.
3. e-Shram was launched in 2019.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
165.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: e-Shram was launched on 26 August 2021; 2019 is the year of PM-SYM, PM-KMY and NPS-Traders. So '1 and 2 only'.
165.tq: 2019 = the three pension schemes; 2021 = e-Shram.

165.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. PM-SYM — 2019
2. PM-KMY — 2019
3. NPS-Traders — 2019
4. e-Shram — 2025
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
165.x: PM-SYM, PM-KMY and NPS-Traders were launched in 2019. e-Shram was launched on 26 August 2021, not in 2025.
165.tq: Locate the one shifted date among an otherwise correct group.

165.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below.

List-I (Scheme)
a. PMAY-Urban
b. PMKVY
c. Ujjwala
 d. Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana

List-II (Objective)
i. Skill development for youth
ii. Affordable housing in cities
iii. Free LPG connections to BPL women
iv. Life and disability cover for rural landless households
165.x: PMAY-Urban concerns affordable urban housing, PMKVY skill development, Ujjwala LPG connections and Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana life and disability cover for rural landless households.
165.tq: Start with the sure housing and LPG pairs, then complete the code.

165.s:
The proposal for a time-use 'gender-complete house' seeks to converge PMAY with which of the following programmes?
1. Jal Jeevan Mission
2. Swachh Bharat Mission
3. Rooftop solar
4. Ujjwala
Which of the statements given above are correct?
165.x: The proposal seeks convergence of PMAY with JJM, SBM, rooftop solar and Ujjwala. All four components are included.
165.tq: Select the complete convergence list instead of a partial combination.

165.s: Which of the following pairs correctly represents insurance penetration and insurance density in FY 2025?
165.x: Insurance penetration was reported at 3.7%, while insurance density rose to USD 97 in FY25.
165.tq: Do not interchange percentage penetration with monetary density.

165.s: The share of people aged 60 years and above is projected to rise from 10.1% to 14.9% during:
165.x: The share of persons aged 60 years and above is projected to increase from 10.1% to 14.9% during 2021–2036.
165.tq: Match both endpoint percentages with the correct projection period.

165.s:
Which of the following statements about Andhra Pradesh's recent social-protection measures is correct?
1. NTR Bharosa provides ₹4,000 per month.
2. The Universal Health Policy provides ₹2.5 lakh of free cover to all.
3. Both measures are limited exclusively to EPFO members.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
165.x: NTR Bharosa provides ₹4,000 per month and Andhra Pradesh's Universal Health Policy provides ₹2.5 lakh of free cover to all. The measures are not limited exclusively to EPFO members.
165.tq: Reject the restrictive statement while retaining the two precise benefit figures.

166.s:
Consider the following statements about PMFBY:
1. It was launched in 2016 and replaced NAIS/MNAIS.
2. The farmer premium is 2% for kharif and 1.5% for rabi crops.
3. The farmer premium for commercial and horticultural crops is 2%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
166.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: the premium for commercial/horticultural crops is 5%. So '1 and 2 only'.
166.tq: PMFBY premium: 2 / 1.5 / 5.

166.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: PMKSY — Har Khet Ko Pani and Per Drop More Crop
e-NAM — Pension for small and marginal farmers
166.x: PMKSY focuses on ‘Har Khet Ko Pani’ and ‘Per Drop More Crop’. Community groundwater management belongs to Atal Bhujal Yojana, pension to PM Kisan Maandhan and crop insurance to PMFBY.
166.tq: Match each scheme with its distinctive objective and reject swapped objectives.

166.s: The components of the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana include:
o: FPO formation and online mandi integration
166.x: The noted components of PMKSY are the Accelerated Irrigation Benefits Programme and watershed development.
166.tq: Identify the components directly associated with the irrigation objective.

166.s:
Consider the following statements about PM-KISAN:
1. It gives Rs 6,000 a year in three instalments to landholding farmers.
2. It was launched in February 2019.
3. It is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme with a 60:40 Centre-State share.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
166.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: PM-KISAN is a 100% Central Sector scheme. So '1 and 2 only'.
166.tq: PM-KISAN = Central Sector, fully Centre-funded.

166.s:
Consider the following statements about PM-PRANAM:
1. It aims to cut chemical fertiliser use to restore the fertility of Mother Earth.
2. The subsidy saved is retained entirely by the Union Government.
3. It was launched in 2023.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
166.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Statement 2 is wrong: States share the subsidy saved. So '1 and 3 only'.
166.tq: PRANAM rewards States with the saved subsidy.

166.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: Atal Bhujal Yojana — World Bank-assisted community groundwater management
PM Kisan Maandhan — online national agricultural market
Soil Health Card — rural road connectivity
e-NAM — pension at the age of 60
166.x: Atal Bhujal Yojana is a World Bank-assisted programme for community groundwater management in seven water-stressed States.
166.tq: Use the funding-partner and objective combination to separate closely related agriculture schemes.

166.s: A small or marginal farmer entering the PM Kisan Maandhan scheme at the eligible age receives a pension of ₹3,000 per month on attaining:
166.x: PM Kisan Maandhan is a contributory pension scheme providing ₹3,000 per month from the age of 60; entry is permitted between 18 and 40 years.
166.tq: Separate the pension age from the scheme's entry-age range.

166.s: Which of the following correctly describes the Soil Health Card scheme?
o: It provides crop insurance and was launched in 2016 at New Delhi.
It provides groundwater cards and was launched in 2019 at Bhopal.
It provides land titles and was launched in 2020 at Hyderabad.
It provides nutrient status and fertiliser advice for each holding and was launched in 2015 at Suratgarh, Rajasthan.
166.x: The Soil Health Card gives the nutrient status of a holding and fertiliser advice. It was launched in 2015 at Suratgarh in Rajasthan.
166.tq: Combine the scheme's function, year and launch location to avoid look-alike programme options.

166.s: The lead agency for e-NAM is:
166.x: The Small Farmers’ Agribusiness Consortium (SFAC) is the lead agency for e-NAM, which links Agricultural Produce Market Committees through an online national agricultural market.
166.tq: Identify the implementing agency rather than the broad objective of the scheme.

166.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
166.x: NREP was introduced in 1980, not 1983. RLEGP was introduced in 1983.
166.tq: Find the single scheme-year mismatch among otherwise familiar chronology pairs.

166.s: Which one of the following statements regarding the lineage of rural self-employment programmes is correct?
o: NRLM was formed by merging NREP and RLEGP in 1989.
DAY-NRLM was renamed as SGSY in 2011.
NRLM was restructured from SGSY and was renamed DAY-NRLM in 2016.
SGSY was restructured from NRLM and renamed in 1999.
166.x: NRLM was restructured from SGSY in 2011 and was renamed Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana–National Rural Livelihoods Mission in 2016.
166.tq: Trace the direction of scheme succession carefully; do not reverse predecessor and successor.

166.s:
Bharat Nirman, launched in 2005, included which of the following as its rural components?
1. Irrigation
2. Roads
3. Housing
4. Telephony
5. Drinking water
6. Electrification
166.x: The six Bharat Nirman components were irrigation, roads, housing, drinking water, electrification and telephony.
166.tq: Check the complete six-item list and reject options that omit one component.

166.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
166.x: SGRY was introduced in 2001. JRY dates from 1989, SGSY/JGSY from 1 April 1999, and NFFWP from 2004.
166.tq: Find the correctly matched year after checking the neighbouring programme dates.

166.s: Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY), which merged IRDP, TRYSEM, DWCRA and allied schemes, started on:
166.x: SGSY started on 1 April 1999 by merging IRDP, TRYSEM, DWCRA and allied schemes (some keys, including APPSC 2025, give 1995). 1989 is JRY, 1993 is EAS, and 2011 is when NRLM was restructured from SGSY.
166.tq: SGSY = 1 April 1999 (learn 1999; recognise 1995 if it is the key's option).

166.s: Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (1989) was formed by merging:
166.x: JRY (1989) merged NREP (1980) and RLEGP (1983). IRDP and TRYSEM went into SGSY (1999); EAS and JGSY formed SGRY (2001); DWCRA was also merged into SGSY.
166.tq: JRY 1989 = NREP + RLEGP; SGRY 2001 = EAS + JGSY; SGSY 1999 = IRDP + TRYSEM + DWCRA.

166.s: With reference to the employment guarantee framework in rural areas, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: VB-G RAM G — 100 days of work per household per year
MGNREGA — 100 days of unskilled manual work per household per year
VB-G RAM G — 75 days of skilled work per household per year
MGNREGA — 125 days of work per household per year
166.x: MGNREGA guaranteed 100 days of unskilled manual work per household per year, whereas VB-G RAM G provides a 125-day guarantee.
166.tq: Use the comparison table to distinguish the changed numerical guarantee.

166.s:
Consider the following statements regarding VB-G RAM G:
1. It replaces MGNREGA.
2. It provides a guarantee of 125 days of work per household.
3. It is implemented by Panchayati Raj Institutions.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
166.x: All three statements are correct. VB-G RAM G replaces MGNREGA, raises the guarantee to 125 days and is implemented through Panchayati Raj Institutions.
166.tq: Check each statement against the status, guarantee and implementing-body rows.

166.s:
Arrange the following events relating to VB-G RAM G in chronological order:
A. The Act came into force
B. The Act was introduced
C. Presidential assent was given
D. The Act was notified
166.x: The sequence is introduction on 16 December 2025, assent on 20 December 2025, notification on 11 May 2026 and commencement on 1 July 2026.
166.tq: Fix the first and last dates, then arrange the intermediate milestones.

166.s: VB-G RAM G is the abbreviated form of:
o: Viksit Bharat—Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin)
Viksit Bharat—Gram Rozgar and Awas Mission
Viksit Bharat—Gramin Rehabilitation and Manufacturing Mission
Village Bharat—Guarantee for Rural Agriculture and Migration
166.x: VB-G RAM G stands for Viksit Bharat-Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin).
166.tq: Test the exact expansion of the scheme acronym.

166.s: The tagline of VB-G RAM G is:
166.x: The stated tagline of VB-G RAM G is “Rozgar Bhi, Samman Bhi”.
166.tq: Recall the official slogan rather than the scheme objective.

166.s:
Consider the following statements about unemployment allowance:
1. Under MGNREGA, it was payable if work was not given within 15 days.
2. Under VB-G RAM G, the allowance and delay compensation are borne fully by the Centre.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
166.x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: under VB-G RAM G the allowance and delay compensation are borne fully by the States. So '1 only'.
166.tq: Allowance cost falls on States.

166.s:
Consider the following statements about MGNREGA:
1. One-third of workers had to be women.
2. The Gram Sabha ran the social audit.
3. It is linked to SDG 1 and SDG 5.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
166.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: MGNREGA links to SDG 1 (No Poverty) and SDG 8 (Decent Work). So '1 and 2 only'.
166.tq: Work = SDG 8.

166.s: Under Section 4(5) of VB-G RAM G, who fixes the State-wise normative allocations?
166.x: Section 4(5) provides that the Centre fixes State-wise normative allocations.
166.tq: Use the “who would do this job?” method for allocation powers.

166.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched regarding funding under VB-G RAM G?
o: All Union Territories, including those with legislatures, receive 100 per cent Central funding
The scheme is a Central Sector scheme in every State
States bear the entire wage and material expenditure in all areas
The Centre-State ratio is generally 60:40, with 90:10 for the North-Eastern and Himalayan States
166.x: VB-G RAM G follows a 60:40 pattern generally and 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States; Union Territories without legislatures receive 100 per cent Central funding.
166.tq: Compare the normal, special-region and Union Territory funding ratios.

166.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The National Council for Land Reforms, set up in 2008, is chaired by the Prime Minister.
2. DILRMP began as NLRMP in 2008.
3. DILRMP became a Central Sector scheme in 2020.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
166.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: DILRMP became a Central Sector scheme in 2016. So '1 and 2 only'.
166.tq: 2008 for both NCLR and NLRMP; Central Sector from 2016.

166.s:
Consider the following statements about Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana:
1. It is under the Ministry of Rural Development.
2. It was launched on 11 October 2014, the birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
166.x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: 11 October is Jayaprakash Narayan's birth anniversary. So '1 only'.
166.tq: SAGY date = JP Narayan's birthday, 11 Oct.

166.s:
Consider the following statements about MPLADS:
1. It is administered by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.
2. Its funds are non-lapsable.
3. Members of Parliament recommend works, while the district authority executes them.
4. It earmarks 15 per cent for SC areas and 7.5 per cent for ST areas.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
166.x: All four statements correctly describe MPLADS: MoSPI administers it, funds are non-lapsable, MPs recommend works, district authorities execute them, and the specified SC/ST earmarks apply.
166.tq: Verify administration, fund character, division of roles and earmarking as separate features.

166.s:
Consider the following statements about DAY-NRLM:
1. It is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme of the Ministry of Rural Development.
2. Funding is 60:40, and 90:10 for North-Eastern States including Sikkim.
3. Union Territories fund it entirely from their own resources.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
166.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: UTs get 100% Central funding. So '1 and 2 only'.
166.tq: UTs = 100% Centre in CSS norms.

166.s: Which of the following Union Territories are excluded from implementation of DAY-NRLM?
o: Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Ladakh
Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
166.x: Delhi and Chandigarh are excluded from implementation of DAY-NRLM.
166.tq: Test the exceptional locations directly, since exclusions are easily confused with coverage.

166.s: Which of the following is NOT a sub-scheme or associated component listed under DAY-NRLM?
166.x: SVEP, AGEY and MKSP are listed under DAY-NRLM. AIBP is a component of PMKSY, not DAY-NRLM.
166.tq: Find the irrigation component wrongly inserted into a rural-livelihood list.

166.s: The target under the Lakhpati Didi initiative is to enable how many women to earn more than ₹1 lakh a year?
166.x: The Lakhpati Didi target is three crore women earning more than ₹1 lakh annually.
166.tq: Distinguish the livelihood-income target from the wider DAY-NRLM membership figure.

166.s: Hariyali, launched in 2003, is associated with:
o: Watershed development through Panchayati Raj Institutions
166.x: Hariyali promotes watershed development through Panchayati Raj Institutions.
166.tq: Use the institutional channel—PRIs—to distinguish Hariyali from other rural schemes.

166.s: Which of the following correctly describes the Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission (SPMRM)?
o: It provides only individual agricultural insurance to landholding farmers.
It issues property cards to village householders through drone surveys.
It constructs all-weather roads exclusively in unconnected habitations.
It develops Rurban clusters by providing urban amenities while retaining the rural soul.
166.x: SPMRM seeks to create Rurban clusters with the phrase ‘rural soul, urban amenities’. It works through convergence and has no separate funding silo.
166.tq: Identify the scheme from its distinctive rural-urban convergence concept.

166.s:
Consider the following statements about SVAMITVA:
1. It is a scheme of the Ministry of Rural Development.
2. It uses drone surveys of village houses and gives property cards.
3. It was launched on 24 April 2020.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
166.x: Statements 2 and 3 are correct. Statement 1 is wrong: SVAMITVA is under the Ministry of Panchayati Raj (24 April is National Panchayati Raj Day). So '2 and 3 only'.
166.tq: SVAMITVA = Panchayati Raj ministry.

166.s:
Which of the following is correctly matched?
1. PM Vishwakarma — Ministry of MSME
2. PM-AJAY — Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
3. PM SVANidhi — Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
4. PMEGP — Khadi and Village Industries Commission as nodal agency
166.x: All four pairs are correct. PM Vishwakarma is under MSME, PM-AJAY under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, PM SVANidhi under MoHUA, and KVIC is the nodal agency for PMEGP.
166.tq: Use institution–scheme matching and eliminate options containing a swapped ministry.

166.s: PM Vishwakarma is intended primarily for:
o: SC-majority villages with more than 500 residents
166.x: PM Vishwakarma covers artisans in 18 traditional trades and provides identity cards, training, toolkits and credit support.
166.tq: Match the programme with its target group rather than its support instrument.

166.s: Which one of the following is NOT a benefit associated with PM Vishwakarma?
o: Collateral-free credit up to ₹3 lakh at 5 per cent interest
Working-capital loans beginning at ₹10,000 for street vendors
166.x: The ₹10,000 working-capital loan is associated with PM SVANidhi. PM Vishwakarma provides the stipend, toolkit support and collateral-free credit mentioned in the other options.
166.tq: Find the benefit belonging to the neighbouring scheme rather than the target scheme.

166.s:
Consider the following statements about PM-AJAY:
1. It is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme of MoSJE for development of SC-majority villages.
2. Its Adarsh Gram component covers villages with 500+ people and over 40% SC population.
3. Its Adarsh Gram component was formerly known as HRIDAY.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
166.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: the Adarsh Gram component was formerly PMAGY (2009-10). So '1 and 2 only'.
166.tq: Adarsh Gram = old PMAGY; HRIDAY is a heritage-city scheme.

166.s: PMEGP is best described as a programme providing:
o: Training and certification under the Skill India Mission
Tap water to all households in statutory towns
Loans to street vendors for working capital only
166.x: PMEGP, launched in 2008, provides credit-linked subsidy for new micro-enterprises, with KVIC as its nodal agency.
166.tq: Match the objective with the correct programme and avoid confusing subsidy with loan-only schemes.

166.s: PM SVANidhi is associated with which of the following?
o: Loans of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for greenfield enterprises
Loans to street vendors, including a first loan of ₹10,000 and a 7 per cent interest subsidy
Loans to artisans up to ₹3 lakh at 5 per cent interest
166.x: PM SVANidhi supports street vendors through working-capital loans; the first loan is ₹10,000 and the scheme provides a 7 per cent interest subsidy and digital cashback.
166.tq: Separate similar credit schemes by beneficiary, initial loan and interest support.

166.s: PM Vishwakarma (2023, Ministry of MSME) is NOT meant for which of the following?
o: Craftspeople needing collateral-free credit up to Rs 3 lakh
Artisans receiving a toolkit up to Rs 15,000
166.x: PM Vishwakarma covers artisans and craftspeople in 18 traditional trades with an ID card, Rs 500/day training stipend, toolkit up to Rs 15,000 and collateral-free credit up to Rs 3 lakh at 5%. It is not for fishermen with non-mechanised boats (the APPSC 2023 trap), so C is the answer; A, B and D are features of the scheme.
166.tq: PM Vishwakarma: 18 trades, MSME; not fishermen (APPSC 2023 trap).

166.s: The budget allocation for SBM-Urban 2.0 was stated to have been halved to which amount in 2026–27?
166.x: The 2026–27 budget allocation for SBM-Urban 2.0 was stated to have been halved to ₹2,500 crore.
166.tq: Identify the precise revised amount rather than the original or a rounded distractor.

166.s: The Urban Challenge Fund is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme under MoHUA involving:
166.x: The Urban Challenge Fund is a ₹1 lakh crore Centrally Sponsored Scheme under MoHUA for FY 2025–26 to 2030–31.
166.tq: Combine the amount, ministry and time period; changing any one creates a false option.

166.s: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs was formed in 2017 by merging which two ministries?
o: Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation and Urban Development
Housing and Finance and Urban Development
Social Justice and Housing and Urban Affairs
166.x: MoHUA was formed in 2017 by merging the Ministry of Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation with the Ministry of Urban Development.
166.tq: Test the exact predecessor ministries rather than a related ministry.

166.s: In June 2023, DAY-NULM entered into a partnership with which organisation to empower women?
166.x: DAY-NULM partnered with UNDP in June 2023 to empower women (APPSC 2023). The World Bank backs Atal Bhujal and SANKALP; UN-Habitat and ADB are distractors.
166.tq: DAY-NULM + UNDP (June 2023) = women's empowerment.

166.s: Which one of the following urban programmes is correctly matched with its objective?
o: Smart Cities Mission - 10,000 e-buses on PPP
AMRUT 2.0 - tap water to all households in statutory towns
166.x: AMRUT 2.0 (2021) aims at tap water to all households in statutory towns and sewerage in AMRUT cities. The Smart Cities Mission covers 100 cities, PM e-Bus Sewa provides 10,000 e-buses, and SBM-Urban 2.0 targets garbage-free cities, so A, C and D are mismatched.
166.tq: Smart Cities 100 cities; AMRUT 2.0 tap water; SBM-U 2.0 garbage-free; e-Bus Sewa 10,000 buses.

166.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Skill India Mission was launched in 2015 with PMKVY as its flagship for short-term training and certification.
2. The nodal ministry for Skill India and PMKVY is the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.
3. PMKVY 1.0 was launched in 2016.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
166.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: PMKVY 1.0 was launched in 2015 (later versions 2.0, 3.0, 4.0). So '1 and 2 only'.
166.tq: Skill India and PMKVY 1.0 both 2015.

166.s: Skill India Digital Hub is:
o: A digital payments platform for street vendors launched in 2020
A digital skilling platform of MSDE launched in 2023
A MoRD programme for rural self-employment launched in 2008
A World Bank fund for urban infrastructure launched in 2021
166.x: Skill India Digital Hub is MSDE’s digital skilling platform, launched in 2023.
166.tq: Distinguish the digital skilling platform from digital-payment and infrastructure programmes.

166.s: SANKALP is best described as a:
o: MoHUA programme providing e-buses to cities
MoRD programme providing self-employment through rural industrial estates
World Bank-supported MSDE programme strengthening district-level skilling institutions
Central Sector scheme providing toolkit grants to artisans
166.x: SANKALP is a World Bank-supported programme of MSDE intended to strengthen district-level skilling institutions.
166.tq: Identify the programme through its international support, ministry and institutional objective.

166.s: Which of the following correctly distinguishes the two skilling programmes of the Ministry of Rural Development?
o: DDU-GKY provides artisan toolkits, while RSETIs provide e-buses.
DDU-GKY is placement-linked for rural youth, while RSETIs focus on self-employment.
DDU-GKY focuses on urban street vendors, while RSETIs provide heritage conservation.
DDU-GKY is a World Bank programme, while RSETIs are run by MoHUA.
166.x: DDU-GKY is a placement-linked programme for rural youth, whereas RSETIs are associated with self-employment.
166.tq: Discriminate between two programmes under the same ministry by their livelihood pathway.

166.s: APSSDC is setting up how many skill hubs in rural colleges with technology firms?
166.x: APSSDC is setting up 50 skill hubs in rural colleges in association with technology firms.
166.tq: Test the exact State-level programme figure.

166.s: Which one of the following is a Central Sector scheme?
166.x: PM Vishwakarma is listed as a Central Sector scheme funded and run centrally. DAY-NRLM, PMAY-G and PM-AJAY are Centrally Sponsored examples.
166.tq: Separate Central Sector schemes from Centrally Sponsored schemes using the funding pattern.

166.s: Which of the following groups consists entirely of Centrally Sponsored Schemes?
o: DAY-NRLM, VB-G RAM G, PMAY-G and PM-AJAY
SEED, PM Vishwakarma and Urban Challenge Fund only
166.x: DAY-NRLM, VB-G RAM G, PMAY-G and PM-AJAY are listed as Centrally Sponsored Schemes. PM-KISAN, PM Vishwakarma, DILRMP and SEED are Central Sector examples, while the Urban Challenge Fund is also Centrally Sponsored.
166.tq: Classify the entire group rather than relying on one familiar scheme.

166.s: The general funding pattern for Centrally Sponsored Schemes, as stated, is:
o: 40:60, with the Centre bearing the smaller share in special States
60:40, 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States, and 100 per cent for Union Territories without legislatures
100 per cent Centre for all schemes
50:50 for all States and 75:25 for Union Territories
166.x: The general pattern is 60:40, changing to 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States and 100 per cent Central funding for Union Territories without legislatures.
166.tq: Remember the normal ratio and its two specified exceptions.

166.s: Which one of the following best describes a major debate concerning the funding of rural employment programmes after the replacement of MGNREGA?
o: Central taxation versus state taxation of agricultural produce
Direct taxation versus indirect taxation of wage income
Urban employment versus rural housing expenditure
Normative allocation formula versus demand-driven funding
166.x: A major debate concerns whether funding should follow a normative allocation formula or remain demand-driven.
166.tq: Identify the opposed concepts forming the comparison rather than selecting a related policy issue.

166.s:
Consider the following statements regarding unemployment allowance under the revised rural employment framework:
1. States now bear the unemployment allowance.
2. The responsibility for unemployment allowance rests entirely with the Union Government.
3. The change has implications for the financial responsibility of the States.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
166.x: Statement 1 is correct: States now bear the unemployment allowance. Statement 2 is false because the responsibility does not rest entirely with the Union Government; statement 3 correctly reflects the resulting State-level financial responsibility.
166.tq: Spot the reversed authority in the statement assigning financial responsibility.

166.s:
Consider the following statements about the convergence of the Green India Mission with MGNREGS:
1. A CAG audit found that the planned convergence was not achieved.
2. The finding concerned the implementation of convergence between two government programmes.
3. The audit concluded that the convergence targets had been fully achieved.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
166.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because the CAG audit found that the planned convergence was not achieved.
166.tq: Find the statement that reverses the audit finding.

166.s: Andhra Pradesh's Amaravati is included under which of the following schemes?
166.x: On the AP side, Amaravati is a HRIDAY city. SPMRM develops Rurban clusters, SVAMITVA does drone surveys of village houses, and PM e-Bus Sewa provides city e-buses.
166.tq: AP angle: Amaravati - HRIDAY; APSSDC - 50 skill hubs.

167.s: The primary objective of Make in India is to:
o: Turn India into a manufacturing hub
Provide public Wi-Fi in urban areas
167.x: Make in India seeks to turn India into a manufacturing hub.
167.tq: Match the flagship initiative with its central objective.

167.s:
Consider the following statements about the PLI scheme:
1. It is a Central Sector scheme.
2. It covers 24 sectors.
3. It now works with the National Manufacturing Mission.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
167.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Statement 2 is wrong: PLI covers 14 sectors (such as electronics, pharma, telecom and auto components). So '1 and 3 only'.
167.tq: PLI = 14 sectors.

167.s: Which one of the following is a feature of Startup India?
o: A ₹10,000 crore fund managed by NHAI
A ₹10,000 crore Fund of Funds managed by SIDBI
A ₹1,000 crore Fund of Funds managed by IREDA
A ₹5,000 crore fund managed by KVIC
167.x: Startup India includes a ₹10,000 crore Fund of Funds managed by SIDBI.
167.tq: Combine the amount, scheme feature and managing agency to avoid agency swaps.

167.s:
Which of the following are features of Startup India?
1. Three-year tax holiday
2. Self-certification under nine labour and environment laws
3. Winding up within 90 days
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
167.x: Startup India provides a three-year tax holiday, permits self-certification under nine labour and environment laws, and provides for winding up in 90 days.
167.tq: Test multiple scheme features together, including the exact number and time period.

167.s: Stand-Up India primarily provides bank loans to:
167.x: Stand-Up India provides bank loans for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs.
167.tq: Match the scheme with its intended beneficiary groups.

167.s: MUDRA stands for:
o: Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency
Medium Units Development and Refinance Authority
Micro Urban Development and Regulatory Authority
167.x: MUDRA means Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency.
167.tq: Test the exact expansion of an acronym using near-identical institutional distractors.

167.s:
Consider the following statements regarding MUDRA:
1. Its nodal ministry is the Ministry of Finance.
2. It was launched in April 2015.
3. Its stated aim is to ‘fund the unfunded’.
4. SC/ST enterprises receive priority.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
167.x: All four statements are correct. MUDRA is under the Ministry of Finance, was launched in April 2015, aims to fund the unfunded, and prioritises SC/ST enterprises.
167.tq: Verify ministry, launch date, slogan-like objective and priority group together.

167.s: Which of the following correctly represents the MUDRA loan categories and limits?
o: Shishu: up to ₹50,000; Kishor: ₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh; Tarun: ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh
Shishu: up to ₹5 lakh; Kishor: ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh; Tarun: above ₹10 lakh
Shishu: up to ₹50,000; Kishor: ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh; Tarun: ₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh
Shishu: up to ₹1 lakh; Kishor: ₹1 lakh to ₹10 lakh; Tarun: above ₹10 lakh
167.x: The three slabs are Shishu up to ₹50,000, Kishor from ₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh, and Tarun from ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh.
167.tq: Arrange the three credit slabs in ascending order and detect the swapped ranges.

167.s:
Consider the following statements about the Solar Charkha Mission:
1. It was launched in 2018 under the Ministry of MSME through KVIC.
2. It sets up solar-powered irrigation pumps for farmers.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
167.x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: it sets up solar-powered spinning and weaving clusters for rural artisans (solar pumps belong to PM-KUSUM). So '1 only'.
167.tq: Charkha = spinning wheel, so artisans, not pumps.

167.s: ZED certification for MSMEs emphasises:
o: Zero Export Duty and zero corporate taxation
Zero Defect and Zero Effect, covering quality and low environmental impact
Zero Electricity Distribution and universal power supply
Zonal Economic Development and export subsidies
167.x: ZED stands for Zero Defect Zero Effect and certifies MSMEs for quality and low environmental impact.
167.tq: Decode the exact expansion and distinguish it from unrelated ‘zero’ policy phrases.

167.s: At which levels is ZED certification available?
167.x: ZED certification is available at Bronze, Silver and Gold levels.
167.tq: Recall the official three-level certification sequence.

167.s: Under the MUDRA scheme, loans are collateral-free up to:
167.x: MUDRA loans are collateral-free up to ₹10 lakh (APPSC 2022 key), i.e. across all three slabs: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,000-5 lakh) and Tarun (₹5-10 lakh). ₹50,000 and ₹5 lakh are only the upper limits of Shishu and Kishor; ₹1 crore is far beyond MUDRA's range.
167.tq: Collateral-free = whole MUDRA range, up to ₹10 lakh.

167.s:
Which of the following statements about PM-DevINE is correct?
1. It is under the Ministry of DoNER.
2. It provides 100 percent central funding.
3. It was announced in Union Budget 2022-23.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
167.x: PM-DevINE is under the Ministry of DoNER, is fully centrally funded, and was announced in Union Budget 2022-23.
167.tq: Combine ministry, funding pattern and announcement year to test the complete scheme profile.

167.s: UDAN is a regional connectivity scheme administered by the:
o: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
167.x: UDAN, or the Regional Connectivity Scheme, is administered by the Ministry of Civil Aviation.
167.tq: Match the transport programme with the correct modal ministry.

167.s:
Consider the following statements about UDAN:
1. It uses capped fares.
2. It provides viability gap funding.
3. It was introduced in 2016.
4. It is implemented as a freight-only railway programme.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
167.x: UDAN was introduced in 2016 and uses capped fares and viability gap funding. It is an air-connectivity scheme, not a freight railway programme.
167.tq: Reject the statement that swaps an aviation scheme with a rail-freight programme.

167.s: PM Gati Shakti is best described as:
o: A National Master Plan for multimodal connectivity using GIS-based integrated planning across ministries
A certification scheme for MSME environmental performance
A programme for financial takeover of DISCOM debt
A scheme for direct LPG subsidy transfer
167.x: PM Gati Shakti, launched in October 2021, is a GIS-based National Master Plan for integrated multimodal connectivity planning across ministries.
167.tq: Identify the programme from its distinctive GIS and cross-ministry planning features.

167.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: Sagarmala — freight-only rail corridors between Ludhiana and JNPT
Sagarmala — economic corridors and border and coastal roads
Bharatmala — highways, including economic corridors and border and coastal roads
167.x: Bharatmala concerns highways, including economic corridors and border and coastal roads. Sagarmala concerns port-led development.
167.tq: Discriminate between two infrastructure programmes by their transport mode and objective.

167.s: The National Infrastructure Pipeline envisaged investment of approximately:
167.x: The National Infrastructure Pipeline envisaged investment of ₹111 lakh crore during 2020-25.
167.tq: Check both the scale of investment and the five-year period.

167.s:
Consider the following statements about Dedicated Freight Corridors:
1. The Eastern corridor runs Ludhiana-Sonnagar/Dankuni and the Western corridor Dadri-JNPT.
2. They are built by NHAI.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
167.x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: DFCs are built by DFCCIL; NHAI builds Bharatmala highways. So '1 only'.
167.tq: DFC = DFCCIL.

167.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. About 657 UDAN routes were operational according to the stated assessment.
2. UDAN was expanding to 120 new destinations.
3. Logistics cost in India is about 13–14 percent of GDP.
4. Logistics cost in developed nations is about 20–25 percent of GDP.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
167.x: The stated figures are 657 running UDAN routes, expansion to 120 new destinations, and Indian logistics costs of about 13–14 percent of GDP. Developed nations are reported at about 8–10 percent, not 20–25 percent.
167.tq: Compare the Indian and developed-country figures while detecting the reversed or inflated range.

167.s: The National Logistics Policy, 2022, primarily aims to:
o: Cut logistics costs through integrated digital systems
167.x: The National Logistics Policy seeks to reduce logistics costs through integrated digital systems.
167.tq: Link a policy to its stated objective rather than to a related infrastructure programme.

167.s: Which one of the following ministries is associated with UJALA, under which LED bulbs and energy-efficient appliances are supplied through EESL?
o: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
167.x: UJALA is associated with the Ministry of Power and promotes LED bulbs and energy-efficient appliances through EESL.
167.tq: Use the ministry–programme association and distinguish Power from New and Renewable Energy.

167.s: PAHAL, also known as DBTL, is administered by which ministry?
o: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
167.x: PAHAL transfers LPG subsidy directly to bank accounts and is associated with the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.
167.tq: Match the subsidy mechanism with its controlling ministry.

167.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the stated 2030 targets of the National Green Hydrogen Mission?
167.x: The stated employment target is 6 lakh jobs, not 50 lakh jobs. The other three figures are targets of the mission.
167.tq: Find the incorrect numerical target among closely related mission figures.

167.s:
Consider the following statements about the National Green Hydrogen Mission:
1. It received Cabinet approval in January 2023.
2. Its outlay is Rs 19,744 crore up to 2029-30.
3. Its nodal ministry is the Ministry of Power.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
167.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: the nodal ministry is MNRE. So '1 and 2 only'.
167.tq: Hydrogen and KUSUM are MNRE; UJALA and UDAY are Power.

167.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the implementation arrangement for the National Green Hydrogen Mission’s Scheme for New and Novel Uses of Hydrogen?
o: BIRAC is its sole implementing agency.
NISE and BIRAC implement it, including support for startup pilots.
Only DFCCIL implements it through freight corridors.
EESL implements it through LED appliance distribution.
167.x: The Scheme for New and Novel Uses of Hydrogen funds startup pilots and is implemented by NISE and BIRAC. Therefore, the claim that BIRAC is the sole agency is incorrect.
167.tq: Reject the absolute ‘sole agency’ claim by identifying the complete institutional arrangement.

167.s: Hydrogen hubs associated with recent progress under the National Green Hydrogen Mission are located at:
167.x: The identified hydrogen hubs are at Kandla, Paradip and Tuticorin.
167.tq: Use location-based elimination among port and coastal centres.

167.s: Under PM-KUSUM, which component is correctly matched with its provision?
o: Component A — 10 GW of decentralised solar power plants
Component B — 10 lakh grid-connected pumps to be solarised
Component C — 17.5 lakh standalone solar pumps
Component A — free rooftop solar systems for urban households
167.x: Component A provides for 10 GW of decentralised solar power plants. Component B concerns 17.5 lakh standalone pumps, while Component C concerns solarisation of 10 lakh grid-connected pumps.
167.tq: Start from the sure component–target pair and eliminate the swapped provisions.

167.s: Renewable energy capacity increased approximately from 2015 to 2025 by which of the following ranges?
167.x: Renewable capacity grew from about 40 GW in 2015 to about 260 GW in 2025.
167.tq: Compare the starting and ending values rather than the total installed power capacity.

167.s: According to the stated energy-capacity figures, installed power capacity is 509.74 GW and the share of renewables is approximately:
167.x: Installed power capacity is 509.74 GW, with renewables accounting for nearly 50 percent.
167.tq: Separate the total capacity figure from the approximate renewable share.

167.s: UDAY, launched by the Ministry of Power in 2015, was aimed at:
o: Financial turnaround of DISCOMs, with States taking over DISCOM debt
Direct transfer of LPG subsidy to bank accounts
167.x: UDAY (2015, Ministry of Power) sought the financial turnaround of power distribution companies, with States taking over DISCOM debt. LED bulbs via EESL is UJALA; LPG subsidy transfer is PAHAL; solar pumps are PM-KUSUM.
167.tq: UDAY = DISCOM debt; UJALA = LED.

167.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Aadhaar is a 12-digit number and was started in 2009.
2. UIDAI works under the Aadhaar Act, 2016, which was amended in 2019.
3. UIDAI works under the National Food Security Act, 2013.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
167.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: UIDAI is governed by the Aadhaar Act, 2016, not the NFSA. So '1 and 2 only'.
167.tq: Aadhaar: 2009 start, 2016 Act, 2019 amendment.

167.s: The Digital India programme rests on how many pillars?
167.x: Digital India rests on nine pillars, extending from Broadband Highways to Early Harvest.
167.tq: Test the exact count and use the named range as a confirmation clue.

167.s: Which one of the following is NOT included among the Central Sector sub-schemes of Digital India?
167.x: e-Governance, the National Knowledge Network and cyber security are Central Sector sub-schemes of Digital India. National Logistics Policy is a separate policy.
167.tq: Find the programme that belongs to a neighbouring policy domain rather than Digital India.

167.s: Which of the following correctly describes BharatNet?
o: A scheme for providing satellite television to all villages
A scheme for providing optical-fibre broadband to all gram panchayats
A programme for manufacturing semiconductor chips
167.x: BharatNet aims to provide optical-fibre broadband connectivity to all gram panchayats.
167.tq: Match the programme with its distinctive infrastructure objective.

167.s: BharatNet was initially known as:
167.x: BharatNet began as the National Optical Fibre Network (NOFN).
167.tq: Discriminate between the present name and the programme’s earlier name.

167.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the India Semiconductor Mission:
1. It was launched in 2021.
2. It functions under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.
3. Its focus includes incentives for display units.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
167.x: All three statements are correct. The mission was launched in 2021, is under MeitY and covers incentives for display units.
167.tq: Verify the year, ministry and objective as a three-part identification test.

167.s: IndiaAI Mission, launched in 2024, is primarily associated with which set of activities?
o: Logistics parks, highways and industrial corridors
Optical fibre, gram panchayats and public Wi-Fi
Fabs, display panels and ATMP units
167.x: The IndiaAI Mission focuses on compute, datasets and artificial-intelligence innovation.
167.tq: Match a specialised mission with its three stated functional components.

167.s: IndiaAI Mission is described as a sub-scheme of:
167.x: The IndiaAI Mission is a sub-scheme of Digital India.
167.tq: Distinguish the parent programme from related industry and startup initiatives.

167.s: Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC) is promoted by:
167.x: ONDC is an open network for digital commerce promoted by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).
167.tq: Use the ‘who promotes it?’ approach to separate DPIIT from digital and financial agencies.

167.s: PM-WANI, launched in 2020, seeks to provide public Wi-Fi through:
o: PDOAs under the Department of Telecommunications
167.x: PM-WANI provides public Wi-Fi through Public Data Office Aggregators (PDOAs) and is associated with the Department of Telecommunications.
167.tq: Match the scheme with both its delivery mechanism and nodal department.

167.s: Which one of the following is NOT included in the identified DPI backbone?
167.x: BharatNet, 5G, UPI, Aadhaar, DigiYatra and FASTag form the identified DPI backbone. PMEGP is an employment-generation programme, not a DPI backbone component.
167.tq: Separate digital public infrastructure components from an unrelated government scheme.

167.s: As indicated in the Economic Survey 2025–26, 5G coverage in India is:
o: Restricted to gram panchayats connected by BharatNet
167.x: The Economic Survey 2025–26 indicates that 5G coverage is nationwide.
167.tq: Test the scope of coverage and reject narrower location-based descriptions.

167.s: Digital India was launched on:
167.x: Digital India was launched on 1 July 2015.
167.tq: Distinguish the exact launch date from other major national programme dates.

167.s: Which factors continue to weaken rural e-governance under BharatNet at the gram-panchayat level?
o: High export duties on software services
Weak fibre upkeep and power cuts
Shortage of urban office space and client spending cycles
167.x: Weak maintenance of fibre infrastructure and power cuts at gram-panchayat level continue to affect rural e-governance.
167.tq: Identify the local implementation constraints rather than broader industry risks.

167.s:
Consider the following statements about the IndiaAI Mission:
1. It was approved in March 2024.
2. Its approved outlay is about Rs 10,372 crore.
3. It gives incentives for fabs, display and ATMP units.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
167.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: fabs, display and ATMP incentives belong to the India Semiconductor Mission; IndiaAI covers compute, datasets and AI innovation. So '1 and 2 only'.
167.tq: IndiaAI = compute and data; ISM = chips.

167.s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
1. SIDBI — MUDRA refinance
2. SIDBI — Fund of Funds for Startups
3. IREDA — renewable-energy financing
4. NHAI — Bharatmala highways
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
167.x: SIDBI is associated with MUDRA refinance and the Fund of Funds for Startups; IREDA is the renewable-energy financing arm; and NHAI is associated with Bharatmala highways.
167.tq: Match agencies with their schemes and watch for authority-swapping traps.

167.s: PM SVANidhi is associated with which nodal agency?
167.x: PM SVANidhi is listed among the schemes associated with SIDBI.
167.tq: Identify the nodal agency from a scheme–agency pairing.

167.s: NICDC is associated with:
o: Industrial corridors and smart industrial cities under DPIIT
Rural electrification under the Ministry of Power
167.x: NICDC is associated with industrial corridors and smart industrial cities under DPIIT.
167.tq: Distinguish the industrial-corridor agency from financing and electrification agencies.

167.s:
Which of the following is correctly matched?
1. EESL — UJALA

167.s:
Arrange the following schemes in chronological order of their launch:
A. Startup India
B. Make in India
C. Atmanirbhar Bharat
D. Digital India
167.x: Make in India was launched in 2014, Digital India in 2015, Startup India in 2016 and Atmanirbhar Bharat in 2020.
167.tq: Fix the earliest and latest schemes first, then order the two middle years.

167.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
167.x: Atmanirbhar Bharat was launched in May 2020, not May 2019. The other pairs are correctly matched.
167.tq: Check the exact year in a familiar launch-date pair rather than relying on the scheme’s general period.

167.s: Which of the following pairs correctly distinguishes the two launch phases of PAHAL?
o: July 2015 launch and nationwide rollout in January 2016
January 2014 launch and nationwide rollout in November 2014
April 2015 launch and nationwide rollout in May 2016
November 2014 launch and nationwide rollout in January 2015
167.x: PAHAL was launched in November 2014 and rolled out nationwide in January 2015.
167.tq: Separate the initial launch date from the later nationwide rollout date.

167.s: Which of the following is identified as a current-relevance issue concerning Andhra Pradesh?
o: Replacement of VCIC by a digital-commerce network
167.x: The PM Surya Ghar drive in Andhra Pradesh is identified as a current-relevance issue.
167.tq: Select the current programme directly associated with the State angle.

167.s: The green-ammonia price-discovery initiative mentioned in the current-affairs context is associated with:
167.x: NGHM is associated with green-ammonia price discovery.
167.tq: Distinguish a green-energy initiative from digital and transport programmes.

167.s:
Which of the following is identified as a criticism or continuing challenge related to the programmes and infrastructure discussed?
1. High logistics cost
2. Low R&D spending
3. Continuing need for support for DISCOM finances
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
167.x: High logistics costs, low R&D spending and the continuing need for support to DISCOM finances are all identified challenges.
167.tq: Consolidate the criticism dimension instead of focusing only on programme objectives.

167.s: Which of the following correctly reflects the Andhra Pradesh angle in the stated infrastructure context?
o: Two industrial corridors and the highest logistics cost in the country
Three industrial corridors, all financed exclusively by SIDBI
One industrial corridor and no significant rooftop-solar position
Three industrial corridors, including VCIC with ADB, and a top-four rank in rooftop solar
167.x: The Andhra Pradesh angle includes three industrial corridors, VCIC’s association with the Asian Development Bank, and a top-four rank in rooftop solar.
167.tq: Combine the State-specific count, partner and ranking while rejecting exaggerated or altered claims.

167.s: Which of the following sets consists of industrial-corridor nodes in Andhra Pradesh?
167.x: Krishnapatnam, Orvakal and Kopparthy are the AP industrial-corridor nodes. Kandla, Paradip and Tuticorin are NGHM hydrogen hubs; Dadri, JNPT and Ludhiana are on the Dedicated Freight Corridors; Sonnagar and Dankuni are Eastern DFC termini and Haldia is a port in West Bengal.
167.tq: AP nodes: K-O-K (Krishnapatnam, Orvakal, Kopparthy).

168.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the nine pillars of Navaratnalu?
168.x: Navaratnalu included Jalayagnam, Pedalandariki Illu, and YSR Aasara/Cheyutha. Stree Shakti is a current Super Six guarantee, not one of the nine Navaratnalu pillars.
168.tq: Find the item belonging to the current guarantee package rather than the earlier nine-pillar programme.

168.s: Navaratnalu was associated with which period?
168.x: Navaratnalu was the nine-pillar welfare framework associated with the period 2019–2024.
168.tq: Discriminate between the programme period and the periods of other State initiatives.

168.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Nethanna Nestham — Auto and taxi owner-drivers
Vahana Mitra — Auto and taxi owner-drivers
168.x: Vahana Mitra is meant for auto and taxi owner-drivers. Rythu Bharosa is for farmers, Nethanna Nestham for handloom weavers, and Matsyakara Bharosa for marine fishermen.
168.tq: Use sector-beneficiary matching to distinguish neighbouring Navaratnalu schemes.

168.s: The annual benefit under Rythu Bharosa, as specified for Andhra Pradesh, is:
168.x: AP’s Rythu Bharosa provides ₹13,500 a year per family, including tenants and ROFR holders. The ₹12,000 per acre figure belongs to Telangana’s Rythu Bharosa, while ₹20,000 is associated with its replacement, Annadata Sukhibhava.
168.tq: Trap a reversed State comparison and distinguish the replacement scheme.

168.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: Vahana Mitra — ₹10,000 a year to auto and taxi owner-drivers
Matsyakara Bharosa — support during the fishing ban
Rythu Bharosa — ₹24,000 a year to handloom weavers
Nethanna Nestham — ₹24,000 a year to handloom weavers owning looms
168.x: ₹24,000 a year is the benefit mentioned for Nethanna Nestham, not Rythu Bharosa. Matsyakara Bharosa supports marine fishermen during the fishing ban, and Vahana Mitra was specified at ₹10,000 a year.
168.tq: Find the wrong beneficiary-benefit combination in a scheme table.

168.s: Which of the following correctly describes Navaratnalu?
o: A self-help group movement based on community participation
A Five-Year Plan focused exclusively on industrial growth
The previous government’s welfare package funded from revenue expenditure
A current central index measuring inclusive development
168.x: Navaratnalu was the previous government’s welfare package and was funded from revenue expenditure.
168.tq: Identify the programme by its character and funding source.

168.s: The ‘Super Six’ in Andhra Pradesh refers to which of the following?
o: A group of six centrally sponsored schemes implemented in Andhra Pradesh
A package of six welfare guarantees of the present State Government
Six constitutional guarantees for economically weaker sections
168.x: Super Six is the present Andhra Pradesh Government’s package of six welfare guarantees.
168.tq: Identify the exact nature of the named package before matching its individual components.

168.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched under the current Super Six guarantees of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Deepam — Free bus travel for women
Annadata Sukhibhava — Direct financial assistance to farmers
Auto Driver Sevalo — Seasonal relief to marine fishermen
168.x: Annadata Sukhibhava provides direct financial assistance to farmers. Stree Shakti concerns free bus travel, Deepam provides LPG cylinders, and Marine Fishing Ban Relief benefits marine fishermen.
168.tq: Use beneficiary-benefit matching and eliminate schemes paired with a neighbouring guarantee.

168.s: The stated objective of Talliki Vandanam is to reduce schooling costs and thereby improve the
168.x: Talliki Vandanam is intended to reduce the cost of schooling and raise the Gross Enrolment Ratio.
168.tq: Link the immediate welfare benefit with its stated educational outcome.

168.s: Stree Shakti provides free bus travel to which beneficiaries under its stated design?
o: All senior citizens and students in Andhra Pradesh
Women and transgender persons domiciled in Andhra Pradesh
Only women domiciled in the capital region
Only women auto drivers and fishermen
168.x: Stree Shakti provides free bus travel for women and transgender persons having Andhra Pradesh domicile.
168.tq: Identify the beneficiary category while avoiding the distractor that restricts the scheme to women alone.

168.s:
Consider the following statements about the Stree Shakti scheme of Andhra Pradesh:
1. It was launched on 15 August 2025.
2. Free travel is available in all APSRTC bus categories without exception.
3. It was later extended to persons with disabilities.
4. Women's share of bus travel rose from 40% to 65%.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
168.x: Statements 1, 3 and 4 are correct: Stree Shakti was launched on 15 August 2025, was later extended to PwD, and women's share of bus travel rose from 40% to 65%. Statement 2 is wrong: free travel covers 5 APSRTC bus categories, not all. So options with 2 (1 and 2 only; 2, 3 and 4 only; all four) are wrong.
168.tq: Remember '5 categories' - any 'all buses' claim is the trap.

168.s: Deepam-2 was launched in 2024. Which earlier Deepam initiative is distinguished from it by providing LPG connections?
168.x: The earlier Deepam, launched in 1999, provided LPG connections, whereas Deepam-2 provides three free LPG cylinders a year.
168.tq: Discriminate between similarly named schemes by comparing their launch years and benefit designs.

168.s: Which of the following correctly represents the instalment pattern of Annadata Sukhibhava assistance?
168.x: The three instalments under Annadata Sukhibhava are ₹7,000, ₹7,000 and ₹6,000, totalling ₹20,000 annually.
168.tq: Check both the order and total of the instalments rather than merely identifying the component amounts.

168.s: Which one of the following statements regarding Annadata Sukhibhava is correct?
o: It excludes tenant farmers from its coverage.
It includes tenant farmers and has a budget provision of ₹6,600 crore for 2026–27.
It is meant only for marine fishermen during the seasonal ban.
It provides ₹15,000 annually to self-owned auto owners.
168.x: Annadata Sukhibhava includes tenant farmers, and the Budget 2026–27 provision mentioned for it is ₹6,600 crore.
168.tq: Use the inclusion or exclusion of a beneficiary group and the budget figure to identify the precise statement.

168.s: Matsyakara Bharosa provides support to marine fishermen during the fishing ban. The benefit was raised from:
168.x: The benefit under Matsyakara Bharosa was raised from ₹10,000 to ₹20,000 per family.
168.tq: Test the original and revised values together rather than either figure alone.

168.s: The Rs 20,000 annual benefit under Annadata Sukhibhava consists of:
o: Rs 10,000 each from the State and PM-KISAN
Rs 15,000 from the State and Rs 5,000 from PM-KISAN
Rs 14,000 from the State and Rs 6,000 from PM-KISAN
Rs 14,000 from PM-KISAN and Rs 6,000 from the State
168.x: The benefit comprises Rs 14,000 from the State and Rs 6,000 through PM-KISAN.
168.tq: Split a composite figure into its stated components.

168.s: Thalliki Vandanam provides an annual amount of how much to mothers of school-going children?
168.x: Thalliki Vandanam provides Rs 15,000 per year to mothers of school-going children.
168.tq: Use nearby welfare figures as numerical distractors.

168.s: The allocation for Thalliki Vandanam in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026–27 is:
168.x: The Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026–27 provided Rs 8,456 crore for Thalliki Vandanam.
168.tq: Separate scheme allocations from benefit amounts and other budget figures.

168.s: Deepam-2 provides which of the following benefits?
o: Three free LPG cylinders per year to 33.32 lakh families
Three free LPG cylinders per year to 83 lakh families
Two free LPG cylinders per year to 83 lakh families
One free LPG cylinder per month to all households
168.x: Deepam-2 provides three free LPG cylinders annually to 83 lakh families.
168.tq: Check the combination of benefit, frequency and coverage.

168.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched with a Super Six promise?
168.x: Deepam provides three free cylinders. Stree Shakti concerns free bus travel, Talliki Vandanam provides ₹15,000 per child, and Aadabidda Nidhi provides a monthly amount to women.
168.tq: Start with the sure scheme-benefit pair and use elimination for the swapped associations.

168.s: The employment-related promise under the Super Six programme consists of
168.x: The promise is for 20 lakh jobs or an unemployment allowance of ₹3,000.
168.tq: Compare the paired job target and allowance amount as one combined promise.

168.s: Aadabidda Nidhi under the Super Six programme provides women with
168.x: Aadabidda Nidhi provides ₹1,500 per month to women.
168.tq: Use exact monthly-amount recall and distinguish it from the unemployment allowance.

168.s: Which of the following correctly describes the change from YSR Vahana Mitra to Auto Driver Sevalo?
o: The scheme changed from annual assistance to free LPG cylinders.
The annual assistance increased from ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 for owners of self-owned autos.
The beneficiary changed from auto drivers to marine fishermen.
The annual assistance decreased from ₹15,000 to ₹10,000 for all transport workers.
168.x: YSR Vahana Mitra provided ₹10,000 annually to self-owned auto or taxi drivers, while the current Auto Driver Sevalo provides ₹15,000 annually to owners of self-owned autos.
168.tq: Compare the old and current scheme names by beneficiary and benefit amount.

168.s: Talliki Vandanam of Andhra Pradesh replaced which earlier scheme that paid ₹15,000 a year to the mother or guardian of a poor child sent to school?
168.x: Talliki Vandanam replaced Jagananna Amma Vodi (launched January 2020), which credited ₹15,000 a year to the mother/recognised guardian of a poor child sent to school or college (APPSC 2023). YSR Cheyutha gave ₹18,750 to women aged 45-60; Aasara repaid SHG loans; Vidya Deevena is fee reimbursement.
168.tq: Amma Vodi (2020) → Talliki Vandanam.

168.s:
With reference to the NTR Bharosa Pension scheme in Andhra Pradesh, consider the following statements:
1. It was earlier known as YSR Pension Kanuka.
2. The monthly pension for old-age and widow beneficiaries was enhanced from ₹3,000 to ₹4,000 from April 2024.
3. The scheme was renamed NTR Bharosa from June 2024 onwards.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
168.x: All three statements are correct. The scheme was known as YSR Pension Kanuka during 2019–24 and was renamed NTR Bharosa, with the pension enhanced to ₹4,000 from April 2024.
168.tq: Use the timeline and check whether the name, period and amount agree.

168.s: The minimum age prescribed for eligibility as an old-age pensioner under NTR Bharosa in Andhra Pradesh is:
168.x: Old-age pension under NTR Bharosa is available to persons aged 60 years and above.
168.tq: Directly recall the age threshold rather than confusing it with the widow-pension age.

168.s: A widow becomes eligible for the widow pension category under NTR Bharosa from the age of:
168.x: The age criterion for widow pension under NTR Bharosa is 18 years and above.
168.tq: Separate the special category age limit from the 60-year old-age pension limit.

168.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched with a category covered under NTR Bharosa?
168.x: Dappu artists are among the categories covered under NTR Bharosa. The other groups listed are not identified as pension categories in the scheme.
168.tq: Identify the beneficiary category and reject unrelated occupational groups.

168.s:
Which of the following groups was specifically included among the special medical and disability-related categories under NTR Bharosa?
1. Dialysis patients
2. Thalassemia patients
3. Persons with severe haemophilia
4. Persons affected by multi-deformity leprosy
Select the correct answer using the code below.
168.x: Dialysis, thalassemia, severe haemophilia and multi-deformity leprosy are all covered special categories under NTR Bharosa.
168.tq: Read the medical-category list carefully; the option containing all four is correct.

168.s:
Which of the following communities were covered by the EWS pension benefit that was enhanced from ₹3,000 to ₹4,000?
1. Arya Vysya
2. Brahmin
3. Kapu
4. EBC
5. Kamma
6. Reddy
7. Kshatriya
Select the correct answer using the code below.
168.x: Arya Vysya, Brahmin, Kapu, EBC, Kamma, Reddy and Kshatriya communities received the same ₹3,000 to ₹4,000 enhancement.
168.tq: Check every item in the community list; a missing EWS group makes a combination incorrect.

168.s:
Arrange the following phases of the old-age and widow pension scheme in chronological order:
A. NTR Bharosa — ₹1,000, later ₹2,000
B. YSR Pension Kanuka — raised in stages to ₹3,000
C. NTR Bharosa — ₹4,000 from April 2024

168.x: The sequence is 2014–19 NTR Bharosa, 2019–24 YSR Pension Kanuka, and June 2024 onwards NTR Bharosa with ₹4,000 from April 2024.
168.tq: Use the period labels and identify the first and last phases before fixing the middle phase.

168.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: Widow pension — eligibility only after 60 years
168.x: Persons with disabilities receive pensions in the range of ₹6,000 to ₹15,000. The old-age and widow pension was ₹4,000 from April 2024, and widow eligibility begins at 18 years.
168.tq: Compare amount and eligibility pairs to detect the reversed or outdated detail.

168.s: Which of the following is correctly matched with the social security pension amount in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Persons with 40% or more disability — ₹6,000 per month, with no age limit
Persons with 40% or more disability — ₹4,000 per month, subject to age above 60
Thalassaemia patients — ₹6,000 per month, subject to age above 60
Widows — ₹10,000 per month, without an age criterion
168.x: Persons with 40% or more disability receive ₹6,000 per month without an age limit. Thalassaemia and similar patients receive ₹10,000.
168.tq: Separate disability eligibility from age-based pensions and disease-specific support.

168.s: Which one of the following is NOT included among the beneficiaries of NTR Bharosa Pension in Andhra Pradesh?
168.x: NTR Bharosa Pension covers elderly persons, widows, single women, weavers, fishermen and artisans; it is not a universal pension for all formal-sector employees above 18 years.
168.tq: Find the category that falls outside the stated beneficiary groups.

168.s: The monthly pension under NTR Bharosa Pension ranges approximately from:
168.x: NTR Bharosa Pension provides monthly pensions ranging from ₹4,000 to ₹15,000 to eligible beneficiaries.
168.tq: Select the correct lower and upper limits of the benefit range.

168.s: The Mukhyamantri Vriddhajan Pension Yojana, for poor people above 60 years, is a scheme of which State?
168.x: Mukhyamantri Vriddhajan Pension Yojana is Bihar's old-age pension scheme for poor people above 60 (APPSC 2019). AP's scheme is NTR Bharosa; Kerala and Telangana are not linked to this scheme name.
168.tq: Vriddhajan = Bihar.

168.s: The Chief Minister’s stated approach to welfare delivery treats which of the following as the basic unit?
168.x: The Chief Minister stated that the family should be the unit for welfare, including family mapping before sanctioning new pensions.
168.tq: Apply the policy principle to the administrative action described in the question.

168.s: Which agency is the nodal agency for NTR Bharosa pensions in Andhra Pradesh?
168.x: SERP is the nodal agency for NTR Bharosa pensions.
168.tq: Apply the ‘who performs this function?’ test to distinguish the nodal agency from health and recruitment bodies.

168.s: The automated monthly distribution of NTR Bharosa pensions uses which mechanism to remove ghost beneficiaries?
168.x: Pension distribution is automated using Aadhaar-based biometric authentication, intended to eliminate ghost beneficiaries.
168.tq: Identify the operational mechanism that directly addresses the stated administrative problem.

168.s: Which statement correctly describes the funding of National Social Assistance Programme pensions in Andhra Pradesh?
o: The pension is financed exclusively through beneficiary contributions.
The entire pension is financed only by municipal bodies.
The State does not contribute to NSAP pensions.
The State tops up the central NSAP pension from its own funds.
168.x: Andhra Pradesh supplements the central NSAP pension amount with funds from the State government.
168.tq: Identify the correct funding relationship instead of assuming a single-level government contribution.

168.s: The 16th Finance Commission found that Andhra Pradesh had the highest among States in respect of:
168.x: The 16th Finance Commission found Andhra Pradesh to have the highest per-capita social security pension spending among States.
168.tq: Focus on the precise comparison—per-capita pension spending—not a broader welfare indicator.

168.s:
Consider the following statements about social security pensions in Andhra Pradesh:
1. The state had 63.12 lakh pensions in December 2025.
2. The monthly expenditure was ₹2,744 crore.
3. Payments are made through biometric, Aadhaar-based authentication.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
168.x: All three statements are correct: there were 63.12 lakh pensions, monthly expenditure was ₹2,744 crore, and payments used biometric Aadhaar-based authentication.
168.tq: Combine beneficiary scale, expenditure and payment mechanism.

168.s: The expenditure on NTR Bharosa pensions in Andhra Pradesh was estimated at what amount in 2026-27?
168.x: NTR Bharosa pension expenditure was estimated at ₹27,719 crore in 2026-27.
168.tq: Distinguish the welfare allocation from interest, capital outlay and revenue-deficit figures.

168.s: Aarogyasri was initially introduced in Andhra Pradesh in 2007 under the leadership of:
168.x: Aarogyasri began in 2007 under Y. S. Rajasekhara Reddy.
168.tq: Match the scheme’s launch year with the person associated with its introduction.

168.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the new health insurance model announced in Andhra Pradesh in May 2025:
1. It proposed coverage of up to ₹25 lakh per family per year.
2. It was intended for about 1.65 crore poor and middle-class families.
3. It was announced by Health Minister Y. Satya Kumar Yadav.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
168.x: All three statements are correct. The model announced in May 2025 proposed annual coverage up to ₹25 lakh for about 1.65 crore poor and middle-class families and was announced by Y. Satya Kumar Yadav.
168.tq: Verify the amount, target population and announcing authority together.

168.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the functions of the 104 and 108 services in Andhra Pradesh?
o: 104 is the health-insurance trust and 108 is the employees’ health scheme.
104 provides mobile medical units with fixed-day village health services, while 108 is an emergency service.
104 provides emergency ambulance services, while 108 conducts fixed-day village clinics.
168.x: The 104 service operates mobile medical units providing fixed-day village health services, whereas 108 provides emergency ambulance services.
168.tq: Discriminate between the two similar-numbered services by matching each number with its function.

168.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Family Physician — pension distribution at the doorstep
104 — fixed-day village health services through mobile medical units
Dr NTR Vaidya Seva Trust — implementation of the health assurance scheme
EHS — cashless treatment for State government employees and pensioners
168.x: Family Physician concerns village-level primary healthcare through PHC doctors, not pension distribution. The other three pairs are correctly matched.
168.tq: Find the one pair that assigns a health or pension function to the wrong programme.

168.s: Which of the following statements about the health indicators and health budget of Andhra Pradesh is correct?
o: The 2026–27 health budget was ₹4,000 crore, with MMR 24 and IMR 45.
The 2026–27 health budget was ₹19,305 crore, with MMR 24 and IMR 45.
The 2026–27 health budget was ₹19,305 crore, with MMR 45 and IMR 24.
The 2026–27 health budget was ₹27,719 crore, with MMR 45 and IMR 24.
168.x: The health budget for 2026–27 was ₹19,305 crore; the reported MMR was 45 and IMR was 24.
168.tq: Check both the budget figure and the order of the two health indicators.

168.s: Aarogyasri (Rajiv Aarogyasri in 2007, later Dr YSR Aarogyasri) in Andhra Pradesh, is presently known as:
168.x: The Aarogyasri scheme, introduced in 2007 as Rajiv Aarogyasri and renamed Dr YSR Aarogyasri in 2019, is now known as Dr NTR Vaidya Seva.
168.tq: Test a renamed scheme through a direct predecessor-successor distinction.

168.s: Under the Universal Health Policy described for Andhra Pradesh, which statement is correct?
o: Every citizen receives free treatment up to ₹2.5 lakh, while poor persons receive treatment up to ₹25 lakh through the NTR Vaidya Seva Trust.
Every citizen receives free treatment up to ₹25 lakh, while poor persons receive only ₹2.5 lakh.
Poor persons are excluded from the insurance mode of treatment.
Only government employees receive free treatment up to ₹2.5 lakh.
168.x: The Universal Health Policy provides free treatment up to ₹2.5 lakh for every citizen, while poor persons receive treatment up to ₹25 lakh through the NTR Vaidya Seva Trust.

168.s: Dr NTR Vaidya Seva (Aarogyasri) in Andhra Pradesh provides cashless care to about:
o: 1.43 crore families covering 3,257 procedures, linked with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
1.65 crore families covering 1,059 procedures, independent of PM-JAY
83 lakh families covering 3,257 procedures, only in tribal areas
1.43 crore individuals covering 500 procedures, only for government employees
168.x: Dr NTR Vaidya Seva gives cashless care to 1.43 crore families for 3,257 procedures and is linked with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. 1.65 crore is the family count of the proposed May 2025 insurance model; 83 lakh is Deepam-2's family count; cashless care for government employees is EHS, a separate scheme.
168.tq: 1.43 crore families, 3,257 procedures, PM-JAY link.

168.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Talli Bidda Express — Free bicycles for adolescent girls
YSR Sampoorna Poshana — Supplementary nutrition through Anganwadis
Giri Gorumudda — Nutrition support for tribal mothers and young children
Badikosta — Free bicycles for Class IX girl students
