168.s: Giri Gorumudda is primarily intended to provide nutrition support to which group?
o: Class IX girl students in municipal areas
Tribal mothers and young children in Agency areas
Poor minority brides in urban areas
168.x: Giri Gorumudda provides nutrition support to tribal mothers and young children in Agency areas.
168.tq: Identify the scheme through its special geographical and beneficiary focus.

168.s: YSR Sampoorna Poshana, including its Plus component in tribal mandals, provides supplementary nutrition to which beneficiaries?
o: Pregnant and lactating women and children aged 6–72 months
Only elderly persons in rural households
168.x: YSR Sampoorna Poshana provides supplementary nutrition to pregnant and lactating women and children aged 6–72 months through Anganwadis. The Plus component applies in tribal mandals.
168.tq: Read the age range and beneficiary categories precisely.

168.s: Sampoorna Poshana or Poshana Plus is primarily associated with:
o: Free house sites for homeless households
Richer take-home rations through Anganwadi Centres
168.x: Sampoorna Poshana/Poshana Plus provides richer take-home rations through Anganwadi Centres.
168.tq: Identify the central service rather than a neighbouring welfare objective.

168.s: In 2024–25, the plain-area delivery of Sampoorna Poshana was known as:
168.x: In 2024–25, Sampoorna Poshana was delivered as Bala Sanjeevani in plain areas. The tribal package included an egg and 200 ml of milk.
168.tq: Distinguish the delivery name from other AP welfare programme names.

168.s: Under YSR Aasara, the outstanding bank loans of women’s Self-Help Groups as on 11 April 2019 were repaid in
168.x: YSR Aasara repaid the outstanding bank loans of women’s Self-Help Groups as on 11 April 2019 in four instalments.
168.tq: Retain the cut-off date and number of instalments as a paired quantitative fact.

168.s: Under Aasara, the 2024–25 assistance mentioned was provided to:
o: 69,597 SHG members through ₹633.74 crore by DBT
2.74 lakh urban SHGs through ₹633.74 crore by DBT
84.47 lakh rural women through ₹18,750 per year
168.x: Aasara provided ₹633.74 crore by DBT to 69,597 SHG members in 2024–25.
168.tq: Link a beneficiary count, amount and delivery mechanism precisely.

168.s: Which statement correctly describes the historical use of the name ‘Cheyutha’?
o: It was originally an Anganwadi nutrition programme.
It first referred to the 2019 Rythu Bharosa programme.
It first referred to a 1998 TDP scheme for handicapped persons.
It was first used in 2022 for Muslim marriage assistance.
168.x: The name Cheyutha first belonged to a 1998 TDP scheme for handicapped persons; it was later used for YSR Cheyutha.
168.tq: Distinguish the present scheme from the earlier scheme bearing the same name.

168.s: Which of the following statements regarding SERP and MEPMA is correct?
o: SERP covers 84.47 lakh rural women, while MEPMA covers 2.74 lakh urban SHGs.
SERP covers 2.74 lakh rural women, while MEPMA covers 84.47 lakh urban SHGs.
SERP is confined to nutrition delivery and MEPMA to housing construction.
Both agencies cover only urban SHGs.
168.x: SERP works with 84.47 lakh rural women, while MEPMA covers 2.74 lakh urban SHGs, so option A is right. Option B swaps the two figures, and SERP and MEPMA are SHG agencies (rural and urban respectively), not nutrition or housing bodies.
168.tq: Use the rural–urban institutional comparison to reject reversed figures.

168.s: YSR Cheyutha (2019-24) provided ₹18,750 a year to which beneficiaries?
o: Kapu, Balija, Telaga and Ontari women aged 45-60
BC, SC, ST and minority women aged 45-60
Self-employed tailors, rajakas and nayee brahmins
168.x: YSR Cheyutha gave ₹18,750 a year to BC/SC/ST/minority women aged 45-60, linking them to livestock units and Pasu Kisan Credit Cards. Kapu, Balija, Telaga and Ontari women of the same age got ₹15,000 under YSR Kapu Nestham; tailors, rajakas and nayee brahmins got Jagananna Chedodu; mothers got Amma Vodi/Talliki Vandanam.
168.tq: Cheyutha ₹18,750 (BC/SC/ST/minority); Kapu Nestham ₹15,000.

168.s: The Andhra Pradesh Disha Bill, 2019 sought to provide for completion of investigation and trial in sexual-offence cases against women within which of the following periods?
o: Investigation within 30 days and trial within 60 days
Investigation within 14 days and trial within 21 days
Investigation within 7 days and trial within 14 days
Investigation within 21 days and trial within 30 days
168.x: The Disha Bill, 2019 proposed completion of investigation within 7 days and trial within 14 days, making the total period 21 days.
168.tq: Separate the two time limits rather than treating 21 days as the investigation period.

168.s: The Andhra Pradesh Disha Bill, 2019 proposed amendments primarily to which of the following laws?
o: The Indian Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure
The Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and the Juvenile Justice Act
The Domestic Violence Act and the Dowry Prohibition Act
The Representation of the People Act and the Indian Evidence Act
168.x: The Disha Bill proposed amendments to the Indian Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure for dealing with sexual offences against women.
168.tq: Identify the exact statutes associated with the proposed legal amendment.

168.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Disha Bill, 2019:
1. The Andhra Pradesh Cabinet approved its withdrawal after the Centre advised reconsideration.
2. The advice was connected with the replacement of the IPC and CrPC by the BNS and BNSS.
3. The BNS and BNSS replaced the IPC and CrPC with effect from 1 July 2024.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
168.x: All three statements are correct. The Bill was withdrawn after the Centre sought reconsideration in the context of the BNS and BNSS, which came into force on 1 July 2024.
168.tq: Check the linked sequence of withdrawal, legislative replacement and effective date.

168.s:
Which of the following were identified as delivery arms of the Disha initiative in Andhra Pradesh?
1. Disha SOS app
2. Disha police stations
3. One Stop Centres
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
168.x: The Disha SOS app and Disha police stations were the delivery arms specifically associated with the Disha initiative. One Stop Centres are a separate support mechanism under Mission Shakti.
168.tq: Distinguish the named delivery arms of one initiative from a related but separate institution.

168.s: A woman facing violence requires police assistance, medical aid, legal support, counselling and temporary shelter at a single location. Which facility is designed for this purpose?
168.x: One Stop Centres provide police, medical, legal, counselling and shelter support to women facing violence under one roof.
168.tq: Match the practical needs in the situation with the institution offering integrated support.

168.s:
Consider the following statements about One Stop Centres (OSC):
1. They are part of the Ministry of Women and Child Development's Mission Shakti, along with Shakti Sadan.
2. They are backed by Women Helpline 181.
3. Women Helpline 181 was universalised in 2024.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
168.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: OSCs are part of MWCD's Mission Shakti with Shakti Sadan, and are backed by Women Helpline 181. Statement 3 is wrong: Helpline 181 was universalised in 2019, not 2024. Hence '1 only' misses statement 2, and the options containing 3 are wrong.
168.tq: OSC = Mission Shakti; helpline 181 universalised 2019.

168.s:
Consider the following statements regarding YSR Kapu Nestham:
1. It covers Kapu, Balija, Telaga and Ontari women.
2. The eligible age group is 45–60 years.
3. The annual assistance is ₹15,000.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
168.x: YSR Kapu Nestham covers Kapu, Balija, Telaga and Ontari women aged 45–60 years and provides ₹15,000 annually.
168.tq: Combine community, age and amount details in a single scheme-identification question.

168.s: Jagananna Chedodu provides annual assistance to which of the following groups, subject to the stated eligibility of having shops?
o: Kapu, Balija, Telaga and Ontari women aged 45–60 years
Self-employed tailors, rajakas and nayee brahmins
Pregnant women and children below six years
Poor minority brides and their parents
168.x: Jagananna Chedodu provides ₹10,000 per year to self-employed tailors, rajakas and nayee brahmins with shops.
168.tq: Distinguish occupational beneficiaries from caste- or gender-based beneficiaries of nearby schemes.

168.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Haj and Jerusalem pilgrimage aid — Minorities
Imam-Mouzzain honorarium — Class IX girl students
Mega DSC coaching — Urban poor seeking subsidised meals
168.x: Haj and Jerusalem pilgrimage aid is provided for minorities. Imam-Mouzzain honorarium is also a minority-welfare measure, while post-matric scholarships and Mega DSC coaching cover SC, ST, BC and minority students.
168.tq: Start with the sure beneficiary pair and reject options that assign benefits to unrelated groups.

168.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Scheme)
a. Chandranna Pelli Kanuka
b. YSR Kalyanamasthu
c. Shaadi Tohfa
d. Dulhan

List-II (Description)
i. Muslim brides
 ii. SC, ST, BC, minorities and disabled
 iii. Same broad groups as Kalyanamasthu
 iv. Muslim brides, introduced in April 2015

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
168.x: Chandranna Pelli Kanuka covered SC, ST, BC, minorities and disabled persons; YSR Kalyanamasthu covered the same broad groups; Shaadi Tohfa was for Muslims; Dulhan was for Muslim brides and began in April 2015.
168.tq: Start with the sure Muslim-bride pair and then complete the community matching.

168.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
168.x: Chandranna Pelli Kanuka was a TDP scheme of 2018. YSR Kalyanamasthu/Shaadi Tohfa belong to 2022, while Dulhan was introduced in April 2015 with ₹50,000 at marriage.
168.tq: Detect swapped parties, years and scheme descriptions in a community-welfare list.

168.s: Dulhan scheme provided which benefit?
168.x: Dulhan was introduced in April 2015 and provided ₹50,000 to Muslim brides at marriage.
168.tq: Identify the exact beneficiary, occasion and amount of marriage assistance.

168.s: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: SC — APSC Co-operative Finance Corporation economic support
SC — ₹5,000–10,000 monthly honorarium to Imams and Mouzams
168.x: The ₹5,000–10,000 monthly assistance to Imams and Mouzams is a minority-welfare measure, not an SC-specific measure. SC welfare includes economic support through the APSC Co-operative Finance Corporation, Jogin rehabilitation and 8.51 lakh pensioners.
168.tq: Separate community-specific measures and reject a benefit belonging to another group.

168.s:
Consider the following statements regarding minority welfare in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Imams and Mouzams receive ₹5,000–10,000 per month.
2. The annual expenditure mentioned for this assistance is ₹180 crore.
3. Urdu is the second official language of the State.
4. Haj and Jerusalem pilgrimage assistance is provided.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
168.x: All four statements are correct: the monthly assistance is ₹5,000–10,000, the annual expenditure is ₹180 crore, Urdu is the second official language, and Haj and Jerusalem pilgrimage assistance is provided.
168.tq: Use an all-correct option when every listed community-welfare feature is supported.

168.s: In Andhra Pradesh Budget 2024-25 (BE), the sector 'Welfare of SC, ST, OBC & Minorities' received about ₹47,277 crore. Which statement about it is correct?
o: It was the largest sector, up about 31% over RE
It was the smallest sector, cut by 31% from RE
It was entirely funded by the Centre
It was merged with the health budget
168.x: Budget 2024-25 BE allotted ₹47,277 crore to Welfare of SC, ST, OBC & Minorities, 31% above RE, making it the largest sector. It was not the smallest or cut, and it was neither fully centrally funded nor merged with health.
168.tq: ₹47,277 cr = largest sector, +31%.

168.s: The stated proposal regarding ration distribution in Andhra Pradesh is that rice should be provided at the rate of:
o: 10 kg for every adult male only
25 kg for every village household only
5 kg for every family, irrespective of family size
5 kg for every family member, treating the family as the unit
168.x: The proposal was to provide 5 kg of rice for every family member, with the family treated as the unit for distribution.
168.tq: Distinguish per-member entitlement from a per-family entitlement.

168.s: Door delivery of ration through mobile dispensing units in Andhra Pradesh began in:
168.x: Door delivery of ration through mobile dispensing units began in 2021.
168.tq: Use the launch year as the distinguishing feature among consecutive years.

168.s: Anna Canteens are primarily intended to provide:
o: Subsidised meals for the urban poor
168.x: Anna Canteens provide subsidised meals primarily for the urban poor.
168.tq: Match the scheme with its target population and service.

168.s: A meal at an Anna Canteen in Andhra Pradesh is priced at:
168.x: Anna Canteens provide a meal priced at ₹5.
168.tq: Recall the flagship unit price associated with the programme.

168.s: Pedalandariki Illu is associated with which of the following objectives?
o: Providing house sites and houses for poor women
Providing cash assistance to self-employed barbers
Providing bicycles to Class IX girls
168.x: Pedalandariki Illu provides house sites and houses for poor women. It is linked with the broader Housing for All effort.
168.tq: Distinguish housing assistance from other welfare benefits with overlapping poor-beneficiary groups.

168.s: Which of the following statements regarding the Housing for All implementation described for Andhra Pradesh is correct?
o: It targeted 7.60 lakh houses by 2026 through PMAY-U and PMAY-G convergence.
It targeted 76 lakh houses by 2024 exclusively through PMAY-U.
It targeted 7.60 lakh houses by 2030 exclusively through PMAY-G.
It targeted 1.60 lakh houses by 2026 through Anna Canteens.
168.x: The stated Housing for All target was 7.60 lakh houses by 2026, using convergence between PMAY-U and PMAY-G and tracking through CFMS.
168.tq: Check the target, deadline and convergence partners together to avoid scale and scheme swaps.

168.s: The AP State Housing Corporation is associated with which programme and motto?
o: Weaker Section Housing Programme — “Housing for All”
168.x: The AP State Housing Corporation, also referred to as APHCL, runs the Weaker Section Housing Programme with the motto “Housing for All”.
168.tq: Match the implementing agency with its programme and motto.

168.s: Under the current housing policy, the house-site entitlement for an eligible homeless household is:
o: 3 cents in rural areas and 2 cents in urban areas
2 square metres in rural areas and 3 square metres in urban areas
3 acres in rural areas and 2 acres in urban areas
2 cents in rural areas and 3 cents in urban areas
168.x: The policy provides house sites of 3 cents in rural areas and 2 cents in urban areas for every eligible homeless household by 2029.
168.tq: Check the direction of a rural–urban size comparison.

168.s: The target year for providing the specified house-site entitlement to every eligible homeless household is:
168.x: The current policy sets 2029 as the target for providing the specified house sites to every eligible homeless household.
168.tq: Distinguish a policy target year from implementation deadlines.

168.s: YSR Jagananna housing under ‘Pedalandariki Illu’ is associated with which date for the launch of houses in Jagananna colonies?
168.x: Houses in Jagananna colonies under YSR Jagananna housing were launched on 3 June 2021.
168.tq: Test the exact date associated with a State housing initiative.

168.s: CLAP, or Clean Andhra Pradesh, primarily focuses on which of the following?
o: Free transport for mothers and newborns
Full fee reimbursement for post-matric students
Door-to-door segregated garbage collection and sanitation
168.x: CLAP focuses on door-to-door collection of segregated garbage and sanitation activities across Andhra Pradesh.
168.tq: Identify the core function rather than an associated environmental output.

168.s: Which of the following is NOT identified as an associated waste-management facility or activity under the CLAP outcomes?
168.x: Waste-to-energy units, compost units and Material Recovery Facilities are associated with CLAP outcomes. Desalination plants are not mentioned as part of these activities.
168.tq: Find the unrelated infrastructure item among closely related sanitation measures.

168.s: The target mentioned for Jal Jeevan Mission coverage in rural Andhra Pradesh is to provide tap connections to all rural households by:
168.x: The stated target is coverage of all rural households by 2027.
168.tq: Distinguish the future target year from the current coverage statistic.

168.s: Which of the following correctly states the performance figures associated with CLAP?
o: 86.07% segregation at source, 6,890 tonnes processed daily and 104 STPs working
96.07% segregation at source, 6,890 tonnes processed daily and 104 STPs working
96.07% segregation at source, 8,690 tonnes processed daily and 140 STPs working
90.07% segregation at source, 5,890 tonnes processed daily and 104 STPs working
168.x: CLAP recorded 96.07% waste segregation at source, processing of 6,890 tonnes daily and 104 functioning STPs.
168.tq: Keep all three linked programme figures together and reject altered digits.

168.s:
Which of the following statements is correct regarding recent sanitation-related developments in Andhra Pradesh?
1. Swachh Andhra is one of the 10 Sutralu.
2. A milestone of 500 ODF Plus villages was reported in January 2026.
3. CLAP was launched on 15 August 2025.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
168.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. CLAP was launched on 2 October 2021, not on 15 August 2025.
168.tq: Find the date-swapped false statement while retaining the two sanitation facts.

168.s: Which of the following correctly represents the sequence of citizen-service initiatives in Andhra Pradesh?
o: MeeSeva preceded e-Seva, and Village Secretariats followed both
e-Seva preceded MeeSeva, and Village Secretariats followed both
Village Secretariats preceded e-Seva, and MeeSeva followed them
MeeSeva, e-Seva and Village Secretariats were all introduced simultaneously
168.x: e-Seva was introduced in 2001, followed by MeeSeva as a single-window service, and Village/Ward Secretariats were introduced in 2019.
168.tq: Use the first and last dates to establish the sequence.

168.s: Which of the following statements regarding Village and Ward Secretariats in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
o: They were introduced in 2015, with 500 secretariats and 10 services.
They were introduced in 2001, with fewer than 100 secretariats and 50 services.
They were introduced in 2024, exclusively for urban taxation services.
They were introduced in 2019, with more than 10,000 secretariats and over 500 services.
168.x: Village and Ward Secretariats were introduced in 2019; the stated figures are more than 10,000 secretariats and over 500 services.
168.tq: Combine the year, institutional scale and service count without swapping the figures.

168.s: The approximate number of jobs associated with the Village and Ward Secretariat system was:
168.x: The Village and Ward Secretariat system was associated with approximately 1 lakh jobs.
168.tq: Recognise the scale marker and reject distractors differing by an order of magnitude.

168.s: The use of DBT through the JAM trinity is intended, among other things, to:
o: Increase the number of intermediaries in welfare distribution
Replace all welfare schemes with food coupons
168.x: Direct Benefit Transfer through the JAM trinity helps reduce ghost beneficiaries and middlemen in welfare delivery.
168.tq: Identify the governance problem addressed by the mechanism rather than its institutional abbreviation.

168.s: Which of the following correctly describes the relationship between Spandana and PGRS?
o: Spandana was a food subsidy and PGRS is a housing scheme
Spandana was a scholarship and PGRS is a health insurance programme
Spandana was the grievance portal and it is now referred to as PGRS
Spandana and PGRS are separate agricultural credit institutions
168.x: Spandana was the grievance portal, now referred to as PGRS. Faster grievance resolution was emphasised by the Chief Minister.
168.tq: Test the renamed-platform relationship instead of treating the two names as separate schemes.

168.s: The GSWS (Amendment) Bill, 2026 is associated with which of the following objectives?
o: Creating a separate pension authority for senior citizens
Replacing the Public Distribution System with direct cash transfers
Revising the roles of functionaries for Swarna Andhra 2047
Merging all Village Secretariats with municipal corporations
168.x: The GSWS (Amendment) Bill, 2026 revises the roles of functionaries in the context of Swarna Andhra 2047.
168.tq: Match the amendment with its stated institutional purpose.

168.s: Under the Zero Poverty P4 approach, which redistribution relationship is proposed?
168.x: Zero Poverty P4 proposes that the top 10% support the bottom 20%.
168.tq: Avoid reversing the two population groups in a redistribution statement.

168.s: Which of the following correctly states the goals associated with Swarna Andhra @2047?
o: End extreme poverty by 2030 and become high-income by 2047
End extreme poverty by 2047 and become high-income by 2030
Achieve high income by 2030 and eliminate inequality by 2047
End poverty by 2026 and achieve high income by 2035
168.x: Swarna Andhra @2047 aims to end extreme poverty by 2030 and attain high-income status by 2047.
168.tq: Keep the earlier poverty target and later income target in sequence.

168.s: The volunteer-based delivery model associated with Andhra Pradesh village and ward secretariats provides approximately one volunteer for every
168.x: The stated volunteer norm is one volunteer for every 50 households.
168.tq: Focus on the ratio and reject nearby numerical distractors.

168.s: How many households have been mapped under the Andhra Pradesh family-oriented welfare delivery exercise?
168.x: The family mapping exercise covered 1.68 crore households.
168.tq: Use exact-figure recall while distinguishing transposed digits and nearby values.

168.s: Which of the following was India’s first integrated citizen service-centre initiative?
168.x: e-Seva, introduced in 2001, was India’s first integrated citizen service-centre initiative.
168.tq: Apply the FIRST-in-sequence clue to distinguish an earlier service platform from later systems.

168.s: Which of the following best describes the criticism of “new welfarism”?
o: It favours direct benefit transfers and tangible transfers over public goods and may strain State finances.
It focuses exclusively on industrial subsidies rather than household benefits.
It prohibits the use of digital payments in welfare delivery.
It replaces all welfare schemes with public hospitals and schools.
168.x: The criticism is that new welfarism prioritises DBT and tangible transfers over public goods and places pressure on State finances.
168.tq: Distinguish the defining policy tendency from exaggerated or absolute alternatives.

168.s:
Consider the following statements regarding social pensions and welfare delivery:
1. Kerala pays ₹2,000 per month as social pension.
2. Kerala is moving from doorstep pension delivery to Direct Benefit Transfer.
3. Andhra Pradesh spends the most per head on social pensions among the States.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
168.x: Kerala’s pension amount is ₹2,000 per month and its delivery is shifting towards DBT; Andhra Pradesh is identified as having the highest per-head social-pension spending among States.
168.tq: Use a comparison question to test amount, delivery mode and inter-State ranking together.

168.s: The national e-Shram platform, launched in August 2021, integrates how many schemes?
168.x: The e-Shram platform integrates 15 schemes.
168.tq: Recall the launch period and exact integration count of a national platform.

168.s: Which of the following correctly states the financial concern associated with Andhra Pradesh welfare commitments?
o: Debt is about 46% of GSDP, making all welfare delivery constitutionally impermissible.
Debt is about 36% of GSDP, contributing to concerns about fiscal strain.
Debt is about 16% of GSDP, with no concern about fiscal sustainability.
Debt is about 26% of GSDP and welfare spending has been eliminated.
168.x: The stated concern is fiscal strain arising in the context of debt of about 36% of GSDP.
168.tq: Select the precise fiscal figure while rejecting exaggerated percentage traps.

168.s: The Opposition’s criticism of the Super Six programme included which of the following claims?
o: It was entirely implemented and pensions were increased without limit.
It was only partly delivered and pensions were cut.
It was confined exclusively to urban households.
It was replaced by the national e-Shram platform.
168.x: The Opposition alleged that the Super Six programme had been only partly delivered and that pensions had been cut.
168.tq: Distinguish a political criticism from the programme’s stated administrative design.

169.s: Swarna Andhra@2047 is primarily intended to provide the framework for which of the following in Andhra Pradesh?
o: The reorganisation of districts completed in 2014
The privatisation of all public-sector undertakings
Only the state’s municipal reforms up to 2030
169.x: Swarna Andhra@2047 provides the framework for the 2024–29 policies and industrial corridors in Andhra Pradesh.
169.tq: Identify the precise scope of the vision instead of choosing an extreme or unrelated policy objective.

169.s:
With reference to the energy objective of Swarna Andhra@2047, consider the following statements:
1. Andhra Pradesh aims to achieve net zero emissions by 2047.
2. The objective is linked with the Integrated Clean Energy Policy and APSES 2024–25.
3. The target year for net zero is 2035.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
169.x: The net-zero target is 2047 and is associated with the Integrated Clean Energy Policy and APSES 2024–25. Statement 3 is false because the target year is not 2035.
169.tq: Split the statements by checking the target year and the policy association.

169.s: Which one of the following is NOT among the panels proposed for the PanIIT Summit 2026?
o: DeepTech, including quantum technology, semiconductors and AI
169.x: The five panels are energy and fuel-cost optimisation; DeepTech; space and defence manufacturing; BioValley; and agri-tech, water and blue economy. Urban tourism and heritage conservation is not listed.
169.tq: Find the option outside the specified five-panel grouping.

169.s:
Consider the following statements about YSR Rythu Bharosa-PM KISAN (2019):
1. It provided ₹13,500 a year per farmer family.
2. The PM-KISAN component of this amount was ₹6,000.
3. It was succeeded by YSR Zero Interest Crop Loans.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
169.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: the scheme gave ₹13,500 a year per farmer family, including PM-KISAN ₹6,000. Statement 3 is wrong: it was succeeded by Annadata Sukhibhava; Zero Interest Crop Loans (2021) is a separate crop-loan scheme. So every option containing 3 is wrong.
169.tq: Rythu Bharosa ₹13,500 → replaced by Annadata Sukhibhava.

169.s:
With reference to YSR Zero Interest Crop Loans, consider the following statements:
1. The scheme was launched on 20 April 2021.
2. Crop loans up to ₹1 lakh become interest-free when repaid on time.
3. The benefit is available only for loans exceeding ₹1 lakh.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
169.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because the scheme covers crop loans up to ₹1 lakh, subject to timely repayment.
169.tq: Find the wrong range statement by checking the upper limit and the word only.

169.s:
Consider the following pairs of Andhra Pradesh agriculture programmes:
1. YSR Jala Kala — Free borewells for small and marginal farmers
2. Rythu Bharosa Kendras — District-level offices only for sanctioning crop loans
3. e-Crop — Digital booking of the crop on every field each season
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
169.x: Pairs 1 and 3 are correct: YSR Jala Kala gives free borewells to small and marginal farmers, and e-Crop digitally books the crop on every field each season (basis for insurance, input subsidy and procurement). Pair 2 is wrong: RBKs (2020) are village one-stop centres for seeds, fertilisers, advisory and procurement. So options containing 2 are wrong.
169.tq: RBK = village-level one-stop shop, not a district office.

169.s: The Crop Cultivator Rights Card (CCRC) under the Andhra Pradesh Crop Cultivators Rights Act, 2019 is intended mainly to provide tenant farmers with:
o: Loans, insurance and input subsidy without affecting the owner's title
Ownership title over the leased land
169.x: The CCRC enables tenant farmers to access loans, insurance and input subsidy without touching the landowner's title.
169.tq: Separate the cultivator's access to benefits from ownership of the land.

169.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the Andhra Pradesh Community-Managed Natural Farming programme?
o: It is community-managed natural farming run by Rythu Sadhikara Samstha since 2016.
It is an industrial credit programme implemented by APIIC.
It is a crop insurance programme administered by the ADB.
It is a centrally managed chemical farming subsidy programme.
169.x: APCNF is community-managed natural farming implemented through Rythu Sadhikara Samstha (RySS) since 2016.
169.tq: Use the implementing organisation and start year to distinguish APCNF from other agriculture programmes.

169.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Its coverage increased along with the rise in extreme-weather crop losses.
2. The farmer premium is 2% for kharif crops, 1.5% for rabi crops and 5% for commercial and horticultural crops.
3. It has been voluntary for all farmers since Kharif 2020.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
169.x: All three statements are correct. PMFBY coverage in Andhra Pradesh rose with extreme-weather losses, and the specified farmer premium rates apply; the scheme has been voluntary for all farmers since Kharif 2020.
169.tq: Check each rate and the time qualifier before selecting the complete coded option.

169.s: The suite of Andhra Pradesh policies designated as “4.0” for 2024–29 was notified on:
169.x: The listed 4.0 policies for 2024–29 were notified on 26 October 2024 and are valid for five years.
169.tq: Distinguish the common notification date from the separate startup-policy date and project-signing date.

169.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Policy)
a. Industrial Development Policy 4.0
b. MSME & Entrepreneur Development Policy 4.0
c. Food Processing Policy 4.0
d. Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0

List-II (Headline goal)
i. Production of USD 50 billion, investment of USD 10 billion and five lakh jobs
ii. One Family, One Entrepreneur and integration with global value chains
iii. Agricultural value addition, cold chains and mega food parks
iv. Promotion of sub-large to ultra-mega projects and an investment target of ₹30 lakh crore

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
169.x: The Industrial Development Policy targets large investment and higher project categories; the MSME policy carries the One Family, One Entrepreneur approach; the Food Processing Policy promotes value addition and cold chains; and the Electronics Manufacturing Policy has the stated production, investment and employment targets.
169.tq: Start with the distinctive slogan and numerical target, then eliminate the remaining codes.

169.s: Which of the following is correctly matched?
o: MSME & Entrepreneur Development Policy 4.0 — G.O.Ms.70, Industries & Commerce (P&I)
Industrial Development Policy 4.0 — G.O.Ms.68, Industries & Commerce (P&I)
Food Processing Policy 4.0 — G.O.Ms.69, Industries & Commerce
Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0 — G.O.Ms.71, Industries & Commerce (Prog.III)
169.x: The Industrial Development Policy 4.0 was issued as G.O.Ms.68 by the Industries & Commerce (P&I) Department. G.O.Ms.69 relates to the MSME policy, G.O.Ms.70 to Electronics Manufacturing, and G.O.Ms.71 to Food Processing.
169.tq: Check the policy–government-order pairing instead of relying only on the policy name.

169.s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh's 4.0 policies (2024-29):
1. The Private Industrial Parks (Plug and Play) Policy 4.0 promotes private parks with ready infrastructure.
2. The Sustainable Electric Mobility Policy 4.0 seeks to build an EV ecosystem.
3. Both policies were notified in April 2025.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
169.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct as per the policy goals. Statement 3 is wrong: the 4.0 industrial policy suite was notified on 26 October 2024; April 2025 is when the Innovation and Startup Policy 4.0 was issued by ITE&C. So options containing 3 are wrong.
169.tq: 4.0 suite = 26 Oct 2024; only the Startup policy is April 2025.

169.s: Which of the following statements regarding project classifications under the Andhra Pradesh industrial policy framework is correct?
o: A large project is defined only by exports, while a mega project is defined only by land area.
A large project has fixed capital investment below ₹501 crore, while a mega project generates fewer than 2,000 direct jobs.
A large project has fixed capital investment above ₹501 crore and up to ₹1,000 crore, while a mega project generates 2,000 or more direct jobs.
A large project requires investment above ₹1,000 crore, while a mega project requires exactly 2,000 direct jobs.
169.x: A large project has fixed capital investment exceeding ₹501 crore and up to ₹1,000 crore. A mega project is associated with 2,000 or more direct jobs; mega and ultra-mega projects may receive case-by-case packages.
169.tq: Keep the investment threshold and employment threshold separate while rejecting reversed ranges.

169.s: The Innovation and Startup Policy (4.0) of Andhra Pradesh for 2024–29 was issued by which department in April 2025?
169.x: The Innovation and Startup Policy (4.0), 2024–29, was issued in April 2025 by the ITE&C (Promotions) Department.
169.tq: Apply the 'which department issued the policy?' trap to distinguish the parent department from a specialised division.

169.s: Which of the following correctly describes the role of the Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation (APIIC)?
o: It regulates aquaculture farms, seed and feed throughout the State.
It functions exclusively as a foreign trade tribunal.
It administers only the State’s green-building certification system.
It is the nodal agency for industrial parks with plug-and-play facilities.
169.x: APIIC is the nodal agency for industrial parks and provides plug-and-play industrial infrastructure.
169.tq: Match the institution with its core administrative function.

169.s: Since June 2026, APIIC has been empowered to allot industrial land up to what area directly, without Cabinet approval?
169.x: Since June 2026, APIIC can directly allot up to 50 acres without Cabinet approval.
169.tq: Check the exact numerical ceiling rather than the institution’s general land-allotment role.

169.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Industrial Corridor Programme projects in Andhra Pradesh:
1. The Centre approved 12 new projects in August 2024.
2. The total number of projects after the approval became 20.
3. Orvakal and Kopparthy are the Andhra Pradesh projects identified under this programme.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
169.x: All three statements are correct: 12 new projects were approved in August 2024, taking the total to 20, with Orvakal and Kopparthy identified for Andhra Pradesh.
169.tq: Verify the number, resulting total and State-specific locations separately.

169.s: Sri City, situated on the Andhra Pradesh–Tamil Nadu border, is best described as a:
o: Government-owned single-product port in Srikakulam district
Pharmaceutical research city in Anakapalli district
Greenfield international airport in Vizianagaram district
Private multi-product Special Economic Zone in Tirupati district
169.x: Sri City is a private multi-product SEZ located on the Andhra Pradesh–Tamil Nadu border in Tirupati district.
169.tq: Use the combination of ownership, product range, location and institutional type.

169.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with the Rayalaseema industrial hub initiatives?
169.x: Kia is associated with Sri Sathya Sai district. Royal Enfield is near Tirupati, JSW Steel is in Kadapa, and the AMCA integration and flight-test centre is another initiative of the hub.
169.tq: Test the institution-location relationship and reject swapped locations.

169.s:
Consider the following statements about the Rayalaseema industrial hub:
1. JSW Steel’s Kadapa project has a Phase-I investment of ₹4,500 crore out of a proposed ₹16,350 crore.
2. A DRDO AMCA integration and flight-test centre is included among the initiatives.
3. A Space City has been proposed near Sriharikota.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
169.x: All three statements correctly describe initiatives associated with the Rayalaseema industrial hub.
169.tq: Check each project detail independently, especially the Phase-I and total investment figures.

169.s: Kopparthy, in YSR Kadapa district, is associated with which of the following?
o: A multi-product SEZ on the Tamil Nadu border
A major fishing harbour and a biofuel park
An electronics manufacturing cluster and an NICP node
A greenfield international airport and an aqua authority
169.x: Kopparthy is associated with an electronics manufacturing cluster and an NICP node in YSR Kadapa district.
169.tq: Use the location-purpose pair to distinguish Kopparthy from Sri City and Bhogapuram.

169.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
169.x: Kopparthy is in YSR Kadapa district and is associated with an electronics manufacturing cluster and an NICP node. It is not a greenfield international airport.
169.tq: Locate the single wrong project-purpose match among familiar Andhra Pradesh infrastructure projects.

169.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The draft Andhra Pradesh PPP Policy-2026 received Cabinet clearance in August 2026.
2. The draft policy proposed a Viability Gap Funding amount of ₹1,500 crore.
3. The draft AP Omnibus Ease of Doing Business Act, 2026 was cleared along with it.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
169.x: All three statements are correct. In August 2026, the Cabinet cleared the draft AP PPP Policy-2026 with VGF of ₹1,500 crore and the draft AP Omnibus Ease of Doing Business Act, 2026.
169.tq: Check the common event, amount and accompanying legislation before choosing the complete combination.

169.s: The Single Desk Portal of Andhra Pradesh has recorded a clearance rate of approximately:
169.x: The Single Desk Portal has recorded a 99.2 percent clearance rate.
169.tq: Distinguish the reported precise percentage from rounded or absolute alternatives.

169.s: Andhra Pradesh was ranked first in the Business Reforms Action Plan (BRAP) in which of the following years or combinations?
169.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked first in 2016 jointly with Telangana, and in 2017 and 2019. BRAP 2020 placed it among the Top Achievers.
169.tq: Track the exact sequence of years and the qualification attached to the 2016 ranking.

169.s: The State Investment Promotion Board (SIPB) of Andhra Pradesh is chaired by the:
169.x: The SIPB is chaired by the Chief Minister; in 2024-25 it approved 8 projects worth ₹2,45,275 crore with 65,541 jobs. The Chief Secretary, Industries Minister and Governor do not chair it.
169.tq: SIPB = CM's board.

169.s: BhuSeva is an integrated land-records platform that assigns each land parcel a unique:
169.x: BhuSeva assigns a unique Bhudhaar number to each land parcel as part of its integrated land-records system.
169.tq: Identify the exact official identifier associated with the land-records platform.

169.s: AP FiberNet, launched in 2017, was designed to provide which combination of services to homes and offices?
o: Only land registration and mutation services
169.x: AP FiberNet is a fibre grid launched in 2017 to provide low-cost broadband, television and telephone services to homes and offices.
169.tq: Select the complete service bundle linked to the fibre grid.

169.s: A citizen grievance is being monitored continuously at a command centre located in the Secretariat. Which Andhra Pradesh system is being used?
169.x: Real Time Governance operates through a command centre at the Secretariat for real-time monitoring of services and grievances.
169.tq: Infer the institutional platform from the location and real-time monitoring function.

169.s: The Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority (APCRDA) functions under which legislation?
o: AP State Aquaculture Development Authority Act, 2020
169.x: APCRDA was established under the APCRDA Act, 2014. The AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 is relevant to Polavaram’s national-project status, not the constitution of APCRDA.
169.tq: Apply the wrong-Act trap by distinguishing similar year-and-subject legislation.

169.s: Polavaram Project is located on the:
169.x: The Polavaram Project is located on the Godavari River.
169.tq: Use the river-project association rather than the district or funding details.

169.s:
With reference to the Polavaram Project, consider the following statements:
1. It is a national project under Section 90 of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014.
2. Its physical progress was 78.64 percent in December 2024.
3. Its target year of completion is 2027.
4. ₹5,449 crore was provided for it in the 2024–25 Budget Estimate.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
169.x: All four statements are correct regarding Polavaram’s legal status, progress, target year and 2024–25 budget provision.
169.tq: Check the statutory provision, percentage, year and rupee figure as separate components.

169.s: The Ramayapatnam port is a greenfield port located on the:
169.x: Ramayapatnam is a greenfield port on the south coast of Andhra Pradesh.
169.tq: Identify the broad geographical location before considering the administrative details.

169.s: The limits of Machilipatnam port were reduced from 64 km to 15 km under the:
o: AP State Aquaculture Development Authority Act, 2020
169.x: The reduction in Machilipatnam port limits from 64 km to 15 km was made under the Indian Ports Act, 2025.
169.tq: Match the numerical change with the correct statutory authority.

169.s: The foundation stone of Amaravati, the capital of Andhra Pradesh, was laid on:
o: 22 October 2015 by Prime Minister Narendra Modi
169.x: Prime Minister Narendra Modi laid Amaravati's foundation stone on 22 October 2015; the capital region is run by APCRDA under the APCRDA Act, 2014. 2 June 2014 is AP's bifurcation date, and the other two options name the wrong date and dignitary.
169.tq: Amaravati: 22-10-2015, PM Modi.

169.s: Which of the following is included in the Andhra Pradesh Integrated Clean Energy Policy, 2024?
o: Only nuclear power and tidal power
Only coal-based power and thermal storage
Solar, wind, hybrid energy, pumped storage and green hydrogen/ammonia
169.x: The policy covers solar, wind, hybrid energy, pumped storage, green hydrogen and ammonia, biofuels, storage and EV charging.
169.tq: Select the comprehensive policy basket and reject options using exclusive wording.

169.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Andhra Pradesh Integrated Clean Energy Policy, 2024:
1. It targets 160 GW of clean energy.
2. It aims for net zero by 2047.
3. It seeks to make Andhra Pradesh a global green hydrogen hub.
4. It was launched in June 2024.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
169.x: All four statements correctly describe the Integrated Clean Energy Policy, 2024.
169.tq: Verify the target, long-term objective, strategic ambition and launch timing separately.

169.s: Which of the following correctly represents the power-sector figures for Andhra Pradesh mentioned for APSES 2024–25?
o: Installed capacity 160,000 MW and renewable capacity 27,392 MW
Installed capacity 34,000 MW and renewable capacity 8,700 MW
Installed capacity 7,522 MW and renewable capacity 27,392 MW
Installed capacity 27,392 MW and renewable capacity 7,522 MW
169.x: The installed power capacity was 27,392 MW, of which renewable capacity was 7,522 MW.
169.tq: Avoid reversing the total installed-capacity and renewable-capacity figures.

169.s: The AP State Aquaculture Development Authority Act, 2020 primarily provides for regulation of:
o: Green buildings and EV charging stations
169.x: The Aqua Authority regulates aqua farms, aquaculture seed and aquaculture feed under the AP State Aquaculture Development Authority Act, 2020.
169.tq: Match the statute with its sector-specific regulatory functions.

169.s: Which one of the following best expresses the stated significance of the Rayalaseema industrial initiatives?
o: The region is being reserved exclusively for agricultural use.
The region is being converted into a single-purpose green-building zone.
The region is being developed only as a coastal port corridor.
The region is being transformed from a drought-prone area into an industrial hub.
169.x: The industrial initiatives signify Rayalaseema’s transformation from a drought-prone region into an industrial hub.
169.tq: Apply the broad regional-development objective to the described industrial projects.

169.s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh’s MSME and export position:
1. 2,61,393 MSMEs were set up in 2024–25.
2. Andhra Pradesh was ranked sixth in exports.
3. The number of MSMEs set up was 1,60,000.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
169.x: Andhra Pradesh recorded 2,61,393 MSMEs set up in 2024–25 and ranked sixth in exports. Statement 3 gives an incorrect number.
169.tq: Check the exact count and rank while detecting the altered numerical distractor.

169.s: Which of the following developments forms part of the current policy relevance of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Abolition of all industrial corridors through a single executive order
Replacement of the Single Desk Portal by a national tax tribunal
Cabinet clearance of the PPP Policy-2026 and Omnibus EoDB Act 2026 drafts
Transfer of APCRDA functions to the Aqua Authority
169.x: The Cabinet cleared the drafts of the PPP Policy-2026 and Omnibus EoDB Act 2026.
169.tq: Identify the genuine current-policy pair and reject institutional-function swaps.

169.s: The PanIIT Summit 2026 associated with Swarna Andhra@2047 is scheduled to be held at which place and on which date?
169.x: The PanIIT Summit 2026 is scheduled at Vijayawada on 3 October 2026 to shape a DeepTech roadmap for Swarna Andhra@2047.
169.tq: Use the place-date combination to distinguish closely related event details.
